column4: Open a role home page with the figures of the user's roles
column6:
As a Marketing TL, I need centralised, real-time dashboards for all roles; details invoked from the dashboard, so that every role sees its work and figures in real time.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: p.5 envisioned 2a and 4c; BR-125 (p.20); BR-152 (p.21); BR-160 (p.22); BR-203 (p.25)
* FRS: FRS BRD-00 Core Replacement v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-00_Core_Replacement_v1.1.docx), section 4.2 Dashboards, FR-CR-010 Open a role home page with the figures of the user's roles
* Persona: Every business user; System Administrator (set-up)
* Function: After sign-in the user lands on a role home page made of widgets. Each widget shows a count, amount or short list from the user's own work (for example "PRFs to review", "Unapplied payments older than 30 days", "Claims without follow-up in 14 days") and refreshes on opening and every 5 minutes (default).

*Business rules*
* (R1) A widget only counts records the user may see (same permission and data scope as the list it opens). (Fixed)
* (R2) Widget sets per role, order and thresholds (for example days overdue) are maintained without a release. (Configurable)
* (R3) Refresh interval 5 minutes (default). (Configurable)
* Check: Widget added twice to a role. Message: "The widget is already on this role's home page"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user is signed in and holds at least one role with a role home configuration, when the user signs in or clicks Home, then a Marketing AO lands on a home page with his pipeline and PR follow-up widgets; a Cashiering user on the cashiering counts.
* (AC2) Given the user is signed in and holds at least one role with a role home configuration, when the user signs in or clicks Home, then a user with the Marketing AO and Collection roles sees both sets once.
* (AC3) Given the user is signed in and holds at least one role with a role home configuration and a widget never, when the user signs in or clicks Home, then it counts a record that its list would not show the user.

column4: Route risks to TSU by rule
column6:
As TSU, I need my involvement to be decided by clear, rule-based criteria, so that my engagement is consistent, predictable and not dependent on ad-hoc or manual routing.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.098 (p.17)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.1 Product lines and product rules, FR-NB-005 Route risks to TSU by rule
* Persona: System; TSU
* Function: TSU involvement is decided by rules, not by manual routing. A rule states a product class (package, non-package or any), line, minimum fleet units, minimum number of locations, a TSI threshold and an endorsement type, with a priority. The product setting ALWAYS or NEVER is checked first; a package above its package TSI limit always goes to TSU (PACKAGE_TSI_LIMIT); otherwise the first matching rule by priority applies.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Delivered rules: NON_PACKAGE (every non-package risk), FLEET_5 (Motor fleet of 5 units or more), TSI_50M (TSI above PHP 50,000,000). (Configurable)
* (R2) The product setting (ALWAYS, NEVER) overrides the rules. (Configurable)
* (R3) TSU clearance is recorded before the account is validated. (Fixed)
* Check: Account needs TSU and has no clearance. Message: "TSU must clear the account first: <reason>"
* Check: Clearance after validation. Message: "TSU clearance is given before the account is validated"
* Check: PRF for a package risk that no rule sends to TSU. Message: "No TSU rule applies to this package risk: quote it directly as a package quotation"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given TSU rules are active in the catalogue and a Motor quotation with 6 vehicles, when the user enters the product, items, fleet size, locations and sums insured, then it shows "TSU required (FLEET_5)".
* (AC2) Given TSU rules are active in the catalogue and an account that requires TSU, when the user enters the product, items, fleet size, locations and sums insured, then it cannot be validated before TSU records the clearance.
* (AC3) Given TSU rules are active in the catalogue and a change to the TSI threshold, when the user enters the product, items, fleet size, locations and sums insured, then it applies to the next evaluation without a release.

*Out of scope / notes*

column4: Track the status of every record through defined stages
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need BIBS to track and update the status of each quotation, proposal and account through defined workflow stages with allowed transitions, so that routing, ownership and reporting are consistent.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.022 (p.70-71; updated p.28); BRNB.115 (p.28-29)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Common workflow, documents and controls, FR-NB-010 Track the status of every record through defined stages
* Persona: System; all users
* Function: Every client, quotation, PRF and account has a work case in one of four workflows (NB_CLIENT, NB_QUOTATION, NB_PROPOSAL, NB_ACCOUNT, section 5). The stages, their owners, SLA hours and the allowed transitions are data. A status changes only through an allowed transition, started by a user action or by the system (for example the payment sweep or e-policy confirmation).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only the transitions of section 5 are possible; there is no manual status edit. (Fixed)
* (R2) SLA hours per stage (defaults in section 5). (Configurable)
* (R3) Stalled = no stage movement for 5 days (default). (Configurable)
* (R4) The account status field mirrors its work case and cannot be edited. (Fixed)
* Check: Action not allowed in the stage. Message: "'<action>' is not allowed while <reference> is in stage <stage>"
* Check: User lacks the permission. Message: "You are not allowed to '<action>'"
* Check: Business action started from the panel. Message: "'<action>' must be done from the record screen"
* Check: Reason missing. Message: "Select a reason for '<action>'"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and an account's History tab, when a user performs a business action (for example Submit, Approve, Send, Validate), then it shows every stage from Draft to Booked with user and time.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS and an attempt to book an account in stage Placed, when a user performs a business action (for example Submit, Approve, Send, Validate), then it is refused with WORKFLOW_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS and an account without movement for 5 days, when a user performs a business action (for example Submit, Approve, Send, Validate), then it is flagged stalled in the Account Status Report.

column4: Void in-process records and distinguish reversal from cancellation
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need to remove prospect or account records that are still in process, with a reason, while they stay in the audit trail, so that lists show only live work and nothing is lost for audit.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.019 (p.68); BRNB.094 (p.15-16)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Common workflow, documents and controls, FR-NB-012 Void in-process records and distinguish reversal from cancellation
* Persona: Authorised user (maker or stage owner)
* Function: A record that is still in process can be voided with a reason from VOID_REASON and a comment: a quotation in DRAFT or FOR_REVIEW, a PRF in DRAFT, FOR_MKT_APPROVAL or WITH_TSU, an account in DRAFT, SUBMITTED or RETURNED_TO_MARKETING. Voiding is the BRD's "deletion": the record is removed from active lists and searches but kept, with its history, for audit.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Void reasons: Duplicate record; Encoding error; Client withdrew the request; Others (see comment). (Configurable)
* (R2) Void is allowed only in the stages listed above. (Fixed)
* (R3) Cancellation reasons (placement and booking): Client request; Non-payment of premium; Loan cancelled or paid off; Insurer request; Others. (Configurable)
* Check: Void without reason. Message: "Select a reason for 'Void'"
* Check: Void of a finalised record. Message: "'void' is not allowed while <reference> is in stage <stage>"

column4: Protect every document that leaves BIBS
column6:

column6:

*Background*

* Persona: Marketing; Processing; System
* Function: Users upload one or several files at once (up to 50) to a client or account, choose the document type, and either keep the source file name or let BIBS nominate a name with the syntax <REFERENCE>_<DOCTYPE>_<n>.<ext>. One file can be linked to several accounts (for example one IDF for a fleet). Users remove a file they uploaded when the record is still editable.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Allowed types: pdf, png, jpg / jpeg, xlsx, xls, docx, doc, csv, ods, odt, msg, eml. (Configurable)
* (R2) Maximum file size 10 MB (default). (Configurable)
* (R3) Nominated names follow <REFERENCE>_<DOCTYPE>_<n>.<ext> until BDOI gives its syntax (Q23). (Configurable)
* (R4) Document types are the LOV DOCUMENT_TYPE (IDF, valid ID, birth certificate, account list, quotation, client acceptance e-mail, e-policy, official receipt, policy copy, KYC form, proof of address, SEC certificate, GIS, secretary's certificate, request e-mail, payment confirmation, hold cover, Insurance Advice, quotation slip, insurer response, comparative table, proposal slip, others). (Configurable)
* (R5) Required documents per product: Motor - IDF; Personal Accident - valid ID (defaults). (Configurable)
* Check: Empty file. Message: "The file is empty"
* Check: File too large. Message: "The file exceeds the maximum size of <n> MB"
* Check: Type not allowed. Message: "Only these file types are allowed: <list>"
* Check: Content does not match the extension. Message: "The file content does not match its .<type> type"
* Check: Malware found. Message: "The file was rejected by the malware scan: <detail>"
* Check: More than 50 files. Message: "Upload between 1 and 50 files at a time"
* Check: Nominate without a reference. Message: "A reference is needed to nominate the file names"
* Check: Required document missing at submission. Message: "Upload the mandatory documents: <types>"

column4: Upload records in bulk with a standard template
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need to receive one or many accepted quotations or proposals, singly or by upload, so that accepted business moves to account creation without rekeying.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.039 (p.90-91); BRNB.064 (p.120); BRNB.024 (p.72-73)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Common workflow, documents and controls, FR-NB-019 Upload records in bulk with a standard template
* Persona: Marketing; Processing; System
* Function: All bulk processing uses one upload wizard. The user downloads the current template (one Excel sheet with what the file is for, who fills it in, its rules and a guide above every column: mandatory, format, allowed values, what to enter), fills it below the example row, and uploads it as it is (.xlsx), or as .ods, .csv or .txt. BIBS checks the header against the template, sanitises each row (trim, case, format), validates every row, and shows valid and invalid rows for review. The user commits; each valid row is processed in its own transaction, so one failure does not stop the others. A summary and an error report (Excel, one line per failed row with the reason) are available after commit.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only the current template is accepted (header check). (Fixed)
* (R2) Maximum 5,000 data rows per file (default). (Configurable)
* (R3) Valid rows are committed; invalid rows are never committed. (Fixed)
* (R4) Sanitisation trims, upper-cases codes and normalises formats; BDOI's own criteria wait for Q14. (Configurable)
* Check: Wrong file type. Message: "Upload an Excel (.xlsx), OpenDocument (.ods), CSV (.csv) or text (.txt) file"
* Check: Missing columns. Message: "The file does not follow the current template; missing column(s): <columns>"
* Check: No data rows. Message: "The file has no data rows"
* Check: Too many rows. Message: "The file has <n> rows; the maximum is <max>"
* Check: Duplicate file. Message: "This file was already uploaded as <job> (<file>)"
* Check: Upload type not allowed. Message: "You are not allowed to use '<upload>'"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has BULK_PROCESS and the permission of the upload, when the user opens Bulk Uploads, selects the upload type and downloads the template, then a file with 100 rows, 3 of them invalid, commits 97 rows and the error report lists the 3 with reasons.
* (AC2) Given the user has BULK_PROCESS and the permission of the upload and a file with a missing column, when the user opens Bulk Uploads, selects the upload type and downloads the template, then it is refused with BULK_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH and no row is processed.
* (AC3) Given the user has BULK_PROCESS and the permission of the upload, when the user opens Bulk Uploads, selects the upload type and downloads the template, then the template downloaded from the wizard is accepted unchanged.

*Out of scope / notes*
* No open clarification on this FR.

column4: Onboard the client - KYC, verification and confirmation
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need a clear and standard way to onboard new clients before any new business starts, so that client details are set up correctly from the beginning and we do not rely on manual or last-minute record creation.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.090 (p.14); BRNB.101 (p.19-20); BRNB.030 (p.79-81); BRNB.029 (p.78-79)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Client onboarding and KYC, FR-NB-034 Onboard the client - KYC, verification and confirmation
* Persona: Marketing AO (maker); Marketing TL (verifier)
* Function: Onboarding is a defined step before New Business is booked. The client moves through the workflow NB_CLIENT - PROSPECT, KYC_REVIEW, KYC_VERIFIED, CONFIRMED (section 5.1). The AO uploads the mandatory KYC documents and submits the KYC; a verifier who is neither the client's creator nor the submitter verifies it; the client is then confirmed.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Mandatory KYC documents - individual - KYC form, valid ID; corporate - KYC form, SEC / DTI certificate, GIS, secretary's certificate. (Configurable)
* (R2) Submit and confirm need the minimum client information and the mandatory documents. (Fixed)
* (R3) The verifier is neither the client's creator nor the KYC submitter. (Fixed)
* (R4) Next review - 36 months (standard and low risk), 12 months (high risk). (Configurable)
* (R5) Deactivation reasons - Duplicate client record; Client request; Deceased / dissolved; No business relationship; Compliance decision; Others. (Configurable)
* (R6) SLA - PROSPECT 72 hours, KYC_REVIEW 24 hours, KYC_VERIFIED 24 hours (defaults). (Configurable)
* Check: Documents missing. Message: "Upload the mandatory KYC documents before you <step>: <documents>"
* Check: Information incomplete. Message: "Complete the client information before you <step>: <fields>"
* Check: Verifier is the maker. Message: "The KYC must be verified by a user other than its maker"
* Check: Confirm without verified KYC. Message: "Client <code> has no verified KYC"
* Check: Confirm a client that is not a prospect. Message: "Only a prospect can be confirmed"
* Check: Account for an unconfirmed client. Message: "Client <code> is not yet confirmed (onboarding and KYC incomplete)"
* Check: Deactivate without reason. Message: "Select a reason for 'Deactivate'"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the client is a prospect; the user has CLIENT_MAINTAIN (submit, confirm) or CLIENT_APPROVE (verify) and a prospect without a valid ID, when the AO uploads the mandatory KYC documents shown in the KYC checklist, then it cannot be submitted for KYC; the message names the missing document.
* (AC2) Given the client is a prospect; the user has CLIENT_MAINTAIN (submit, confirm) or CLIENT_APPROVE (verify), when the AO uploads the mandatory KYC documents shown in the KYC checklist, then the AO who submitted the KYC cannot verify it.
* (AC3) Given the client is a prospect; the user has CLIENT_MAINTAIN (submit, confirm) or CLIENT_APPROVE (verify), when the AO uploads the mandatory KYC documents shown in the KYC checklist, then after confirmation, the client shows both PR and CL codes and the status Confirmed client.
* (AC4) Given the client is a prospect; the user has CLIENT_MAINTAIN (submit, confirm) or CLIENT_APPROVE (verify) and an account, when the AO uploads the mandatory KYC documents shown in the KYC checklist, then it cannot be created from a quotation of an unconfirmed client (CLIENT_NOT_CONFIRMED).

column4: Create and update clients in bulk

*Background*

* Persona: Marketing; System
* Function: Marketing uploads a list of clients on the standard template (FR-NB-019). For each row, BIBS updates the client found by prospect or client code (blank cells keep the current values), else the client found by a single hard duplicate key, else creates a new prospect. Every row is validated like the screen (formats, lists, duplicates), invalid rows are flagged with the reason and not saved.

*Business rules*

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has BULK_PROCESS and CLIENT_MAINTAIN and an upload of 50 rows with 5 existing client codes, when the user downloads the template, fills it and uploads it, then it updates those 5 and creates 45 prospects.
* (AC2) Given the user has BULK_PROCESS and CLIENT_MAINTAIN and a row with an invalid mobile, when the user downloads the template, fills it and uploads it, then it is refused and listed in the error report.

* Function: Users tag a client with controlled values (list CLIENT_TAG) and record special instructions with a type, text and effective dates. column4: Receive quotation and proposal requests
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need to receive quotation and proposal requests from clients, branches and source systems in one place, so that every request is captured and traced to its quotation.

*Background*

* Persona: Marketing AO; System
* Function: Every request is logged in the Quotation Requests inbox with a number REQ-yyyy-nnnnnn, its channel (list SOURCE_CHANNEL), source reference, client or prospect, requested product, segment and cover. A request received by e-mail is captured by the AO with the e-mail attached (document type REQUEST_EMAIL). Requests from a source system are loaded as a file (upload QUOTATION_REQUEST) or through the source-system intake port.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Request numbers REQ-<yyyy>-nnnnnn. (Configurable)
* (R2) A source reference is unique per channel. (Fixed)
* (R3) Channels - E-mail; Home Loan System (HLS); Bulk upload; Branch referral; Walk-in / direct. (Configurable)
* (R4) Every request keeps its channel, so the source (for example HLS) is traceable. (Fixed)
* Check: No client and no prospect name. Message: "Give the client code or the prospect's name"
* Check: Duplicate source reference. Message: "Request <reference> of <channel> was already received"
* Check: Create prospect for a request that has a client. Message: "Request <number> has a client"
* Check: Close without reason. Message: "Give the reason for closing"
* Check: Action on a closed request. Message: "Request <number> is already <status>"

* (AC2) Given the user has QUOTE_MAINTAIN (capture) or QUOTE_VIEW (view) and a request file loaded from the HLS extract, when the AO clicks Capture Request, enters the request details and attaches the e-mail, then it creates one request per row with channel HLS.

* Persona: Marketing AO
* Function: The AO creates a quotation (for example IDF, FFYMI) in a wizard - client or prospect, product, risk items, premium, review. A client or prospect code is enough (BRNB.029); a quotation of a prospect with incomplete information is flagged. BIBS rates the risk with the Appendix A formulas (FR-NB-062) and shows the live premium breakdown.

* (R2) Default validity 30 days from creation. (Configurable)
* (R3) Submission needs at least one item, a rated premium and a validity that has not passed. (Fixed)

* (R5) The intake template version is stamped on the quotation. (Fixed)

* Check: Product not offered to segment. Message: "Product <code> is not offered to segment <segment>"
* Check: Direct payment not allowed. Message: "Product <code> cannot be paid directly to the insurer"
* Check: Period end not after start. Message: "The period end must be after the period start"
* Check: Validity in the past. Message: "The validity date cannot be in the past"
* Check: No items. Message: "Add at least one risk item"
* Check: Premium not computable. Message: "The premium cannot be computed: give each item a sum insured (and a rate when the product has no default rate)"
* Check: Validity passed at submission. Message: "The validity date has passed: change it before submitting"
* Check: Product changed. Message: "The product of a quotation cannot change"

column4: Approve or return a quotation
column6:

column4: Record client acceptance and create the accounts
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need to record the client's acceptance and generate the list of accounts of an individual quotation, so that accounts are created from what the client accepted.

*Background*

* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Quotation, FR-NB-045 Record client acceptance and create the accounts
* Persona: Marketing AO
* Function: When the client accepts by e-mail, the AO attaches the acceptance e-mail (document type CLIENT_ACCEPTANCE), records the acceptance with the accepted risk groups and a comment (ACCEPTED), and creates the accounts. BIBS creates one draft account per accepted risk group with the premium of the group, the insurer, the payment arrangement and the quotation's creator as account officer (CONVERTED). A quotation with one account passes its own ARN; with several, the accounts carry ARN-yyyy-nnnnnn-01, -02 and so on.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One account per accepted risk group. (Fixed)
* (R2) Accounts carry the quotation's ARN (with -nn suffix when several). (Fixed)
* Check: No acceptance e-mail. Message: "Attach the client's acceptance e-mail (document type Client acceptance e-mail) first"
* Check: Unknown risk group. Message: "The quotation offers risk groups <groups> only"
* Check: Create accounts before acceptance. Message: "Record the client's acceptance first"
* Check: Client not confirmed. Message: "Client <code> is not yet confirmed (onboarding and KYC incomplete)"
* Check: Bulk risk groups badly written. Message: "Risk groups are numbers separated by ';'"

* (AC1) Given the quotation is SENT_TO_CLIENT (accept) or ACCEPTED (create accounts); account creation needs a confirmed client (FR-NB-034), when the AO uploads the acceptance e-mail, then a quotation with risk groups 1 and 2, of which the client accepts group 1, creates one account with the quotation's ARN.
* (AC2) Given the quotation is SENT_TO_CLIENT (accept) or ACCEPTED (create accounts); account creation needs a confirmed client (FR-NB-034), when the AO uploads the acceptance e-mail, then accepting without the acceptance e-mail is refused.

column4: One Account Reference Number from quotation to invoice
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need each Proposal Request Form to get its reference number automatically when it is created, so that every request can be tracked without manual numbering.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.102 (p.20); BRNB.006 (p.61-62)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Quotation, FR-NB-047 One Account Reference Number from quotation to invoice
* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS generates one ARN (ARN-yyyy-nnnnnn) at quotation or PRF creation, or at direct account creation, and carries it unchanged on the account, placement slip, hold cover, e-policy, Insurance Advice, invoice, service invoice, reports and interfaces. Several accounts from one quotation carry the ARN with a two-digit suffix. Users search and open any record by its ARN.

*Business rules*
* (R1) ARN format ARN-<yyyy>-nnnnnn, or ARN-<yyyy>-nnnnnn-nn for split accounts; gap-free, never re-used, not editable. (Fixed)
* (R2) The format of the BDOI number follows BDOI's answer to Q15; the ARN prefix is the proposed default (chapter 21, CLR-NB-35). (Configurable)
* Check: Invalid ARN given. Message: "The ARN must read ARN-yyyy-nnnnnn (or ARN-yyyy-nnnnnn-nn)"

When the client accepts, the AO attaches the acceptance e-mail and records the accepted risk groups (ACCEPTED), then creates one draft account per risk group with the PRF's ARN, the chosen insurer and its quoted rate (CONVERTED). column4: Compute the premium (Appendix A)
column6:
As Processing, I need to book a multi-year insurance policy, so that coverage, billing and financial processing are correctly established over the policy term.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.051 (p.109-111); Appendix A (p.226); BRNB.112 (p.25-26)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Account, FR-NB-062 Compute the premium (Appendix A)
* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS rates every quotation and account with the Appendix A formulas and the rates of the catalogue in force on the period start. Property - net premium = TSI x rate; DST 12.5% of net premium; premium tax, fire service tax and LGT (rate of the insurer branch) on net premium; gross premium = net premium + charges; commission = commission rate x net premium; VAT on commission 12%. Motor - OD / Theft coverage = TSI x OD factor (annual 90%, multi-year 81%); OD / Theft premium = coverage x rate; BI and PD premiums from the limit tables; basic premium = OD / Theft + BI + PD; DST 12.5%, VAT 12% and LGT on the basic premium. Other lines - TSI x rate with the taxes of the line.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Rates - DST 12.5; VAT 12 (Property 0); premium tax Property 12; FST Property 2; motor OD factors 90 / 81 (defaults). (Configurable)
* (R2) Short-period percentages by months covered 1-12. (Configurable)
* (R3) Commission from the insurer x product rate, else the insurer-wide rate. (Configurable)
* (R4) LGT rate from the insurer branch. (Configurable)
* (R5) Minimum premium not applied to endorsements or pro-rata periods. (Fixed)
* Check: No item. Message: "Enter at least one item to rate"
* Check: Sum insured negative. Message: "Enter a sum insured of zero or more for every item"
* Check: Rate missing. Message: "Enter the premium rate of <item>"
* Check: OD factor not set up. Message: "The motor OD/Theft coverage factor is not set up"
* Check: Limit not in the table. Message: "<coverage> limit <amount> is not in the limit table"
* Check: Short-period rate missing. Message: "No short-period rate is set up for <n> month(s)"
* Check: Period invalid. Message: "The period end must be after the period start"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given Items have sums insured; a rate is on the item or is the product default and a Property item of TSI 1,000,000 at 0.25%, when the user enters or changes items, period or rating basis, then it gives net premium 2,500.00, DST 312.50, premium tax 300.00, FST 50.00 plus LGT.

* (AC3) Given Items have sums insured; a rate is on the item or is the product default and a pro-rata period of 180 days, when the user enters or changes items, period or rating basis, then it gives 180/365 of the annual premium without the minimum premium.

* Persona: System
* Function: Before an account is saved, BIBS compares its risks with the live accounts of the company (every status except VOIDED and CANCELLED). Motor - the plate number, conduction sticker, engine number or chassis / serial number (normalised alphanumeric) of any item matches an item of another account. Fire and property - the same client, the same normalised location of risk and the same insured items. A match blocks the save, and the fall-out names the existing ARN and the matching identifier.

* (R1) Live accounts = all statuses except VOIDED and CANCELLED. (Fixed)
* (R2) CTPL versus Motor package exception. (Fixed)
* (R3) Endorsements - duplicates flagged, not blocked. (Fixed)
* (R4) Fire location match - exact on the normalised address and city (Q22). (Fixed)

* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the user saves an account, or a bulk row is processed, then a Fire account for the same client, address and insured items as a live account is refused.

column4: Maintain the Free First Year register
column6:

* Persona: Marketing AO
* Function: An eligible account is tagged Free First Year with its FFY start; BIBS sets the FFY end to one year less a day after the start. The tag is set on the account (Tag Free First Year) or by upload (FFY_TAGGING), which finds each account by its vehicle identifier and refuses a row that matches none or several accounts. Users edit the FFY start and cancel the tag with a reason; the account itself is not deleted and the cancelled tag stays visible.

*Business rules*
* (R1) FFY end = start + 1 year - 1 day. (Fixed)
* (R2) Only FFY-eligible products and active accounts are tagged. (Fixed)
* (R3) Cancellation reasons - Auto loan cancelled; Dealer promo withdrawn; Tagged in error; Others. (Configurable)

* Check: Start missing. Message: "Enter the Free First Year start"

* Check: Vehicle matches none or several. Message: "No live account insures vehicle <id> / Several accounts insure vehicle <id>: <ARNs>"
* Check: Bulk action invalid. Message: "Action must be TAG or CANCEL"

* Persona: Marketing AO; System
* Function: The payment arrangement of an account is "Premium paid through BDOI" or "Direct payment to the insurer". Direct payment is offered only for products that allow it (configurable criterion). * (AC2) Given the product allows direct payment, when the AO selects Direct payment to the insurer on the account, then the booked invoice of a direct-payment account has no client premium receivable.

A slip is generated only when every account meets the prerequisites - stage Ready for placement, payment or client confirmation recorded (unless direct payment), required documents present, TSU clearance given when required, and insurer and branch usable. *Business rules*
* (R1) One slip per insurer branch; an account is on one current slip. (Fixed)
* (R2) Prerequisites - READY_FOR_PLACEMENT; payment confirmed or direct payment; documents complete; TSU cleared; insurer usable. Segment-specific prerequisites wait for Q26. (Fixed)
* (R3) Slip statuses - GENERATED, SENT, SUPERSEDED. (Fixed)

* Check: Prerequisites not met. Message: "Placement prerequisites not met - <ARN>: <problem> / ..."

* Check: Regenerate a superseded slip. Message: "Slip <number> was already replaced"

* Persona: Processing; System
* Function: The placement details sent to the insurer include the EOPT (Ease of Paying Taxes) details of the client, so that the insurer can issue its tax documents to the right taxpayer. The EOPT details are the taxpayer name (the registered name of a corporate client, the full name of an individual), the TIN and the registered address, and any further EOPT field that BDOI lists (chapter 21, CLR-NB-45). BIBS takes them from the client record (FR-NB-031, FR-NB-032) and prints them in an EOPT block of the placement slip PDF and in the EOPT columns of its Excel file.

*Business rules*
* (R1) EOPT details - taxpayer name, TIN, registered address; taken from the client record, never keyed on the slip. (Fixed)
* (R2) The details sent are those in force at the final submission to the insurer; a change after generation regenerates the slip before sending. (Fixed)
* (R3) Further EOPT fields and whether missing details block the sending follow BDOI's answer (CLR-NB-45). (Configurable)

* Function: The recipient of the system-triggered sending of the Insurance Advice is kept in the MIS set-up: per mortgagee bank, and where needed per segment or branch of the bank, the recipient e-mail addresses and the enrolment for automatic sending. *Business rules*
* (R1) Automatic sending only for an advice whose mortgagee is enrolled in the MIS set-up. (Configurable)
* (R2) The advice is encrypted with a password; the password is sent in a separate e-mail. (Fixed)
* (R3) An enrolment or a recipient change is authorised by a second user. (Fixed)

column4: Book an account with its GL entry and service invoice
column6:
As Processing, I need to book accounts individually or in bulk and process positive financial endorsements, so that premiums, commissions and receivables are recorded correctly.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.027 (p.76-77); BRNB.061 (p.118-119); BRNB.108 (p.23-24)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.10 Booking, FR-NB-110 Book an account with its GL entry and service invoice
* Persona: Processing (BOOKING_PROCESS); System
* Function: Processing books an account whose policy is issued (or that is flagged for direct booking). The Pre-booking Confirmation shows the invoice(s) with the premium breakdown and commission, and the journal preview. On Book Account BIBS, in one step (all or nothing) - checks the account, the cost center and the insurer shares; creates the invoice BI-<branch>-yyyy-n on the booking date; posts the BROKER_BOOKING accounting event per insurer share (premium receivable from the client unless direct payment, premium payable to the insurer, commission receivable, VAT on commission, withholding tax); opens the open items; issues the service invoice when a type is triggered on booking (FR-NB-117); and moves the account to BOOKED.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Booking, GL entry and service invoice are created together: all or nothing. (Fixed)
* (R2) The booking date cannot be in the future. (Fixed)
* (R3) Commission realisation ON_COLLECTION (default) or ON_BOOKING. (Configurable)
* (R4) Withholding tax on commission 10% (default). (Configurable)
* (R5) GL accounts of the event are set up in Accounting Rules; production values wait for OQ07. (Configurable)
* Check: Account not issued. Message: "Account <ARN> is <status>: only issued policies are booked"
* Check: Already booked. Message: "Account <ARN> is already booked (BRNB.076)"
* Check: Future booking date. Message: "The booking date <date> is in the future"
* Check: Cost center missing. Message: "Enter the cost center of account <ARN> (BRNB.108)"
* Check: No insurer / period / premium. Message: "Account <ARN> has no insurer / has no period of cover / has no rated premium"
* Check: Company has no branch. Message: "The company has no branch to book invoices"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the account is POLICY_ISSUED; the user has BOOKING_PROCESS, when processing opens the account from Ready to Book, then booking an issued account creates the invoice, the balanced journal and the service invoice, and the account shows Booked.
* (AC2) Given the account is POLICY_ISSUED; the user has BOOKING_PROCESS, when the journal cannot be posted, then the account stays Policy issued and no invoice exists.
* (AC3) Given the account is POLICY_ISSUED; the user has BOOKING_PROCESS, when processing opens the account from Ready to Book, then booking the same account twice returns the existing invoice.

column4: Book individually or in batch, on schedule or by upload
column6:
As Processing, I need to book accounts individually or in batches, manually or by upload, with their triggers, so that large volumes are booked without one-by-one work.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.036 (p.87-88); BRNB.061 (p.118-119)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.10 Booking, FR-NB-111 Book individually or in batch, on schedule or by upload
* Persona: Processing
* Function: Individual booking books one account at a time (FR-NB-110). For batch booking, Processing selects accounts and clicks Add to Batch; the Placement Workbench action For Booking hands accounts over the same way. Before the batch runs, Processing edits the booking date or cost center of an entry, removes an entry, cancels the batch or confirms the selected entries. The batch runs at the scheduled time (default 20:00 PHT) or at once with Book Now. Each account is booked in its own transaction; failures go to the Failed tab with the reason and do not stop the others.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One active queue entry per ARN. (Fixed)
* (R2) Batch schedule daily 20:00 PHT (default). (Configurable)
* (R3) Batch runs are numbered BB-<yyyy>-n with one result row per account. (Fixed)
* Check: Nothing selected or queued. Message: "Select at least one account to book / No queued account to book"
* Check: Future booking date. Message: "The booking date <date> is in the future"
* Check: Entry no longer queued. Message: "Account <ARN> is no longer queued (<status>)"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the accounts are POLICY_ISSUED and ten accounts queued and confirmed, when processing selects accounts on Ready to Book and clicks Add to Batch, then they are booked by the evening run; one without cost center fails and the others are booked.
* (AC2) Given the accounts are POLICY_ISSUED and an entry removed from the queue, when processing selects accounts on Ready to Book and clicks Add to Batch, then it is not booked.
* (AC3) Given the accounts are POLICY_ISSUED and an upload of 50 ARNs, when processing selects accounts on Ready to Book and clicks Add to Batch, then it books the valid rows and lists the failures.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-NB-10 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Changes before batch booking (BRNB.036; FR-NB-111). Proposed: Before a batch is booked, Processing changes the booking date and the cost center, removes an account from the queue or cancels the batch. Other account details are changed on the account. column4: Book multi-year policies
column6:
As Processing, I need to book a multi-year insurance policy, so that coverage, billing and financial processing are correctly established over the policy term.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.112 (p.25-26)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.10 Booking, FR-NB-114 Book multi-year policies
* Persona: Processing; System
* Function: A multi-year account (for example a 5-year term) is identified as multi-year on the account and carries one policy number per year (FR-NB-101), all linked to its ARN. Booking creates one invoice per policy year - year 1 is booked at once, years 2 to n are stored SCHEDULED and booked by the batch job when their year starts. Each year has its own premium, commission and policy number, and the history shows every year.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One invoice per policy year, transaction numbers NB, NB-Y2 ... NB-Yn. (Fixed)

* Persona: Processing (positive, non-financial); Adjustment (negative)
* Function: An endorsement is recorded against a booked account with a number EN-yyyy-n. A financial endorsement - positive (additional premium) or negative (return premium) - is booked as an invoice with its effective date, booking date, description and the change of sum insured and premium. The premium is computed on the remaining term (pro-rata days or the short-period table) or entered, and the minimum premium does not apply. The preview shows the invoice and journal before posting. column4: Mark booked and fully paid transactions with an incentive eligibility indicator
column6:
As Processing, I need booked and fully paid transactions to be marked with an incentive eligibility indicator, after the applicable endorsements are considered, so that incentive processing and reporting are accurate and auditable.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.107 (pp.4-5; Workshop p.22-23)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.10 Booking, FR-NB-118 Mark booked and fully paid transactions with an incentive eligibility indicator
* Persona: System
* Function: Incentive eligibility rule (the same rule applies to Renewal, BRD-6 BRRN.041): a transaction is evaluated for incentive eligibility only when it is booked and fully paid, after the applicable endorsements are considered. It is not evaluated at quotation, placement, issuance or booking of an unpaid or partly paid invoice. The indicator is re-evaluated when an endorsement is posted on the booked transaction and when the booking is cancelled, and every decision is logged with the rules applied.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Evaluation only for a booked and fully paid transaction; never before booking or before full payment. (Fixed)
* (R2) The evaluation considers the mother policy attributes and every applicable financial endorsement posted on it. (Fixed)
* (R3) Indicator = at least one matching active criterion (Eligible); otherwise Not eligible; Pending until fully paid. (Fixed)
* (R4) Re-evaluation on every posted financial endorsement and on cancellation of the booking. (Fixed)
* (R5) The indicator is not changed by hand; any authorised override follows BDOI's decision (CLR-NB-46). (Fixed)
* (R6) Criteria are maintained with maker-checker in BRD-3. (Configurable)
* Check: Change of a frozen booking rule. Message: "Incentive rules are maintained in Product Maintenance > Incentive Criteria"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given Active incentive criteria exist; the payment status of the invoice is received from Collections and a booked invoice that is unpaid or partly paid, when an account is booked; the indicator reads Pending (not fully paid), then it shows the indicator Pending (not fully paid) and no criterion code.
* (AC2) Given Active incentive criteria exist; the payment status of the invoice is received from Collections, when the invoice becomes fully paid, then an invoice on a product covered by an active criterion shows Incentive = Eligible and the criterion code; the decision and the rules applied are in the history.
* (AC3) Given Active incentive criteria exist; the payment status of the invoice is received from Collections, when an account is booked; the indicator reads Pending (not fully paid), then a financial endorsement posted after full payment that changes a criterion attribute re-evaluates the indicator, and the history shows both decisions.
* (AC4) Given Active incentive criteria exist; the payment status of the invoice is received from Collections, when an account is booked; the indicator reads Pending (not fully paid), then cancelling the booking sets the indicator to Not eligible with the reason.
* (AC5) Given Active incentive criteria exist; the payment status of the invoice is received from Collections, when an account is booked; the indicator reads Pending (not fully paid), then the indicator cannot be edited on the invoice.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-NB-28 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Incentive criteria (BRNB.107; FR-NB-118). Proposed: The incentive criteria are maintained in Product Maintenance (BRD-3) and stamped on the invoice when it is evaluated (CLR-NB-46); computation and payout are out of scope. Decision requested: Provide the criteria content (Q33).
* CLR-NB-46 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Incentive indicator at full payment (BRNB.107; FR-NB-118; BRD-6 BRRN.041). Proposed: One rule for New Business and Renewal: evaluation only when the transaction is booked and fully paid, after the applicable endorsements are considered; re-evaluation on every posted financial endorsement and on cancellation; each decision logged with the rules applied. Pending until fully paid. No manual change of the indicator. Decision requested: Confirm the reading of fully paid (all instalments; an endorsement with an unpaid premium), the endorsements that count, and whether an authorised override is needed (if so, by which role, with a reason and a second user).

As a Business Administrator, I need a retention policy applied to quotations, accounts and client records, including those that did not proceed or were voided, so that records are kept, archived or purged consistently and remain available for audit during their retention.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRNB.106 (p.22); Data retention (p.92)
* FRS: FRS BRD-01 New Business v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-01_New_Business_v2.1.docx), section 4.12 Administration, FR-NB-137 Apply the retention policy
* Persona: System; Business Administrator
* Function: Retention rules per record type and status (years online, years in archive, action REVIEW or ARCHIVE) cover clients (inactive, never-confirmed prospects), quotations and PRFs (not proceeded, voided) and accounts (voided, cancelled). A monthly job (RETENTION_REVIEW) counts the eligible records per rule; users list them from the rule. Records stay available until the retention period ends, and every run is logged.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Default 5 years online and 15 years archive for every rule (p.92). (Configurable)
* (R2) Backup every 4 hours with 5 years of backup retention is an infrastructure setting (NFR, section 8). (Fixed)
* Check: Years invalid. Message: "Years online must be positive and years in archive not negative"
* Check: No status. Message: "Enter at least one status"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has MASTER_VIEW (view) and MASTER_MAINTAIN (edit rules), when the job runs monthly and stores the counts, then the review lists voided quotations older than 5 years.
* (AC2) Given the user has MASTER_VIEW (view) and MASTER_MAINTAIN (edit rules), when the job runs monthly and stores the counts, then no record is deleted by a review run.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-NB-27 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Retention, archive and purge (BRNB.106; FR-NB-137). Proposed: Retention rules and review counts are kept in BIBS; nothing is deleted. The physical archive and purge follow the storage and backup decision. Decision requested: Decide the archive and purge approach (Q39).

column4: Keep the invoice ledger of every booked invoice
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need to view the payment history of each invoice, with the payment dates, the amounts applied and the AR numbers, so that every Operations team sees the same, traceable payment data at invoice level.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRQID.007 (annex p.3); MKTID.011 (p.138; annex p.63)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.1 Access, invoice ledger and Invoice 360, FR-OP-004 Keep the invoice ledger of every booked invoice
* Persona: System
* Function: Each invoice booked in New Business, each endorsement invoice and each return invoice is copied into the Operations invoice ledger after the booking commits. The ledger line holds the ARN, invoice, policy, PN numbers, client, assured and payor, lead insurer and insurer shares, currency, booking, inception and expiry dates, risk code, product line, segment, AO and unit, the direct payment and 2% CWT flags, and the amounts per component.

*Business rules*
* (R1) BOOKED movements come only from the booking feed. (Fixed)
* (R2) A movement is unique on module, source reference, invoice, component and type; posting the same source twice has no effect. (Fixed)
* (R3) Payment status is derived from the PR balances (UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID). (Fixed)
* (R4) Keys (ARN, invoice, client, insurer) are stored as values, so the ledger can be replayed from booking at any time. (Fixed)
* (R5) The payment history is view-only outside Cashiering (BRQID.007); Remittance and the other teams cannot add or change a payment application. (Fixed)
* Check: Movement without an amount. Message: "A movement needs at least one amount other than zero"
* Check: BOOKED movement from a module. Message: "BOOKED movements come from the booking feed only"
* Check: Replay without scope. Message: "Give an invoice number, an ARN or a company to replay"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the invoice is booked in New Business and a booked invoice, when New Business books an invoice, then it appears in Invoice Search with its components equal to the booking, status UNPAID and WITH_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE.
* (AC2) Given the invoice is booked in New Business and a payment applied to the invoice, when New Business books an invoice, then it shows as an APPLIED movement with the AR number, date and amount per component.
* (AC3) Given the invoice is booked in New Business, when New Business books an invoice, then a Remittance Processor opening Invoice 360 of a paid invoice sees the payment history (payment date, amount applied, AR number) and has no action to change a payment application.
* (AC4) Given the invoice is booked in New Business and a direct payment account booked in New Business, when New Business books an invoice, then it shows the DP chip and payment status NOT_APPLICABLE.
* (AC5) Given the invoice is booked in New Business, when New Business books an invoice, then replaying an invoice already in the ledger changes nothing.

column4: Lock invoices while a team works on them
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need BIBS to coordinate invoice adjustments, remittance exemptions and accounting entries in the right sequence, so that no two teams change the same invoice at the same time.

*Background*

* Persona: System; Remittance, Adjustment
* Function: A module locks an invoice while it works on it, with the owner module and a reason. Remittance locks each invoice in a batch until the DV number is received or the line is excluded or returned; Adjustment locks the invoice while a request is open. Other modules may still apply payments to a locked invoice; any other action is refused with INVOICE_LOCKED.

*Business rules*
* (R1) While locked, other modules may post only APPLIED movements. (Fixed)
* (R2) Only the owner module releases its lock. (Fixed)
* (R3) Lock reasons are free text until BDOI lists them (OQ28). (Configurable)
* Check: Action on a locked invoice. Message: "Invoice <invoice> is locked by <owner> (<reason>)"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and an endorsement request on an invoice that is in a remittance batch, when a team starts work on an invoice (extraction into a batch, an endorsement request), then it is refused with INVOICE_LOCKED naming REMITTANCE.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS and a payment applied to an invoice locked by Adjustment, when a team starts work on an invoice (extraction into a batch, an endorsement request), then it is accepted.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a team starts work on an invoice (extraction into a batch, an endorsement request), then excluding the invoice from the batch releases the lock.

column4: Maintain AR and OR series per branch
column6:
As the Cashiering TL / TH, I need BIBS to assign AR and OR numbers per transaction from the series of the branch, with ORs issued by Head Office only, so that receipt numbers are controlled, unique and compliant with BIR.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CSHID.006 (p.91-92); CSHID.015 (p.100)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Cashiering, FR-OP-010 Maintain AR and OR series per branch
* Persona: Cashiering TL / TH (maintain); System (numbering)
* Function: A receipt series is kept per kind (AR or OR) and branch, with prefix, first and last number, BIR ATP number and the warning level. ARs are numbered from the series of the branch of the transaction; ORs only from Head Office series. A number is taken when the receipt is posted, under a row lock, so two receipts never get the same number.

*Business rules*
* (R1) OR series belong to Head Office only. (Fixed)
* (R2) Series are maker-checker. (Fixed)
* (R3) Series format and ATP ranges follow BDOI's BIR registration (OQ05). (Configurable)
* Check: OR series for a branch other than HO. Message: "Official receipt series belong to Head Office only (CSHID.006)"
* Check: Last number below first. Message: "The last number must not be below the first number"
* Check: Last number below issued numbers. Message: "The last number cannot be below the numbers already issued"
* Check: No series left. Message: "No authorized <kind> series with numbers left for this branch (CSHID.015)"
* Check: Maker authorises own series. Message: "The requester cannot approve"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CASH_SERIES_MANAGE and a branch AR, when the TL adds a series with kind, branch, prefix, range, ATP number and warning level, then it takes the next number of the branch series; an OR takes the next Head Office OR number.
* (AC2) Given the user has CASH_SERIES_MANAGE and an OR from a branch series, when the TL adds a series with kind, branch, prefix, range, ATP number and warning level, then it is refused with OR_HEAD_OFFICE_ONLY.
* (AC3) Given the user has CASH_SERIES_MANAGE, when the last number is used, then the next receipt is refused with RECEIPT_SERIES_DEPLETED.
* (AC4) Given the user has CASH_SERIES_MANAGE, when the TL adds a series with kind, branch, prefix, range, ATP number and warning level, then no two receipts carry the same number.

column4: Receive a payment and issue an Acknowledgement Receipt
column6:
As a Cashier, I need to create, cancel and reinstate Acknowledgement Receipts for premium and non-premium payments, so that every payment received is receipted, and corrected only through a controlled cancellation or reinstatement.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CSHID.001 (p.86-87)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Cashiering, FR-OP-011 Receive a payment and issue an Acknowledgement Receipt
* Persona: Cashier
* Function: The cashier records a premium payment (Bills Payment, OTC, Trade, CLPC, PDC, Direct Credit) or a non-premium payment (refund, other expenses, AR Insurance). BIBS issues an AR numbered from the branch series, in the currency received, converted at the BOOK rate.

*Business rules*
* (R1) AR classes and channels are the list AR_CLASS (premium: Bills Payment, OTC, Trade, CLPC, PDC, Direct Credit; non-premium: Refund, Other expenses, AR Insurance). (Configurable)
* (R2) A receipt is in the currency received and posted at the BOOK rate with 2 decimals (CSHID.012). (Fixed)
* (R3) The AR number is taken from the series of the branch of the user at posting. (Fixed)
* Check: Amount zero or negative. Message: "A receipt needs an amount above zero"
* Check: No AR series left. Message: "No authorized AR series with numbers left for this branch (CSHID.015)"
* Check: Mandatory field blank. Message: "<Field> is required"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CASH_RECEIPT; the branch has a usable AR series and an OTC payment on a booked invoice, when the cashier opens Receive Payment and enters the payor, reference, amount, currency, mode and check details, then it issues an AR with the next branch number and applies the payment; the invoice becomes PAID when fully covered.

As a Cashier, I need to choose the reason for the cancellation of an AR or OR, so that every cancellation carries a reason that can be audited.

*Background*

* Check: Others without text. Message: "Specify the reason when 'Others' is selected"
* Check: Receipt already cancelled. Message: "Receipt <no> is already cancelled"
* Check: Request already waiting. Message: "Receipt <no> already has a request waiting for approval"

column4: Reinstate a cancelled receipt
column6:
As a Cashier, I need to choose the reason for a reinstatement, so that every reinstatement carries a reason from the agreed list.

*Background*

* Persona: Cashier (request); Cashiering TL / TH (approve)
* Function: A cancelled receipt is reinstated in full or in part as a separate transaction RIN-yyyy-n, with a reason from REINSTATEMENT_REASON and the encoded fields of the reason group. On approval BIBS restores the receipt (status REINSTATED), posts OPS_RECEIPT_REINSTATE for the reinstated amount, applies it to the encoded invoice and keeps the rest unapplied.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Reason groups PREMIUM and DIRECT_PAYMENT with the BRD values (section 9.2). (Configurable)
* (R2) Premium reasons apply to ARs. (Fixed)
* (R3) The reinstated amount is above zero and at most the receipt amount. (Fixed)
* Check: Receipt not cancelled. Message: "Only a cancelled receipt can be reinstated"
* Check: Amount out of range. Message: "The reinstated amount must be above zero and at most <amount>"
* Check: Fields of the group missing. Message: "Enter the <fields> (CSHID.005)"
* Check: Premium reason on an OR. Message: "Premium reinstatement reasons apply to ARs"
* Check: No reason. Message: "Select a reason"

column4: Match payments at acceptance and handle pre-booked payments
column6:
As a Cashier, I need BIBS to match each payment at acceptance, except an issued PDC, and apply it to booked accounts or keep it as pre-booked or unapplied, so that money is applied as soon as it is received.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CSHID.020 (p.103-104)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Cashiering, FR-OP-018 Match payments at acceptance and handle pre-booked payments
* Persona: System; Cashier (pre-booked queue)
* Function: Every payment except a warehoused PDC is matched at acceptance on the ARN, invoice, policy or PN number. The outcome is one category: APPLIED (booked invoice with outstanding PR; applied up to 100%, or 98% for 2% CWT clients); PREBOOKED (account found but not booked yet); UNAPPLIED_NO_MATCH (no account found); EXCESS (payment above the outstanding amount; the excess stays unapplied); CANCELLED_REFERENCE (invoice or slip cancelled).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Application of 2% CWT clients is limited to 98% of the premium; the 2% waits for the BIR 2307. (Configurable)
* (R2) Several outstanding invoices of one reference are paid oldest first. (Fixed)
* (R3) Pre-booked ageing threshold 5 days (default). (Configurable)
* (R4) The match key of pre-booked payments is ARN, invoice, policy or PN until BDOI confirms it (OQ12). (Configurable)
* Check: Pre-booked item already processed. Message: "Pre-booked payment of <ARN> is <status>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and a payment of 10,000.00 on a booked invoice of 10,000.00, when a payment is received (counter, file or PDC), then it is APPLIED in full.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a payment is received (counter, file or PDC), then for a 2% CWT client the same payment applies 9,800.00 and leaves 200.00 unapplied.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a payment is received (counter, file or PDC), then a payment by ARN before booking is PREBOOKED and is applied automatically when the invoice is booked.
* (AC4) Given the step is due in BIBS and a payment quoting a cancelled invoice, when a payment is received (counter, file or PDC), then it becomes unapplied with origin CANCELLED_REFERENCE.

column4: Apply payments by premium component hierarchy
column6:

* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS applies each payment to the premium receivable of the invoice component by component in the order: DST, premium tax / VAT, LGT, FST, other charges, basic premium. column4: Clear minimal balances when the payment is processed
column6:
As a Cashier, I need BIBS to clear minimal premium balances and minimal excess payments automatically when the payment is processed, within a configurable threshold and except for the 2% CWT, the DST charged or the entire premium, so that trivial residuals never reach the unapplied or disposition work and need no manual action.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CSHID.016 (p.100-101; annex p.4 and 6-7)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Cashiering, FR-OP-023 Clear minimal balances when the payment is processed
* Persona: System; Cashiering TL (thresholds, safety-net run)
* Function: Minimal balances are cleared by the system in the same transaction that processes the payment (acceptance at the counter, a payment file, a matured PDC, a re-application or a disposition that applies money), with no user action, approval or tagging (Cashiering annex, CSHID.016). When the application leaves a premium receivable balance within the minimal balance threshold, BIBS reverses it (OPS_MINIMAL_BALANCE_REVERSAL, ledger MIN_BAL), unless the balance equals the client's 2% creditable withholding tax, the DST charged or the entire premium. When the payment exceeds the receivable by an amount within the threshold, BIBS moves the excess to AP overages (OPS_EXCESS_TO_OVERAGES) instead of creating an unapplied item.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Premium threshold 10.00; reverse, except a balance equal to the 2% CWT, the DST charged or the entire premium. (Configurable)
* (R2) Excess threshold 10.00; moved to AP overages at processing, never to Unapplied Payments. (Configurable)
* (R3) COMMISSION rule inactive until BDOI confirms it (OQ11). (Configurable)
* (R4) A component is cleared once; no second automatic reversal of the same transaction. (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a payment is being processed, or the safety-net run starts and a payment of 9,995.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00, when BIBS applies the payment by component (FR-OP-019), then it clears the remaining 5.00 in the same posting; no unapplied item and no disposition are created.
* (AC2) Given a payment is being processed, or the safety-net run starts and a payment of 10,008.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00, when BIBS applies the payment by component (FR-OP-019), then it moves the excess of 8.00 to AP overages; the Unapplied tab shows nothing for it.
* (AC3) Given a payment is being processed, or the safety-net run starts and a payment of 10,050.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00, when BIBS applies the payment by component (FR-OP-019), then it creates an unapplied item of 50.00 (above the threshold).
* (AC4) Given a payment is being processed, or the safety-net run starts and a remaining balance of 5.00 that equals the DST charged, when BIBS applies the payment by component (FR-OP-019), then it is not reversed.
* (AC5) Given a payment is being processed, or the safety-net run starts, when BIBS applies the payment by component (FR-OP-019), then running the safety-net sweep after these payments changes nothing.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-09 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Minimal balances (CSHID.016, ADJID.026; FR-OP-023, 059). Proposed: Minimal balances are cleared when the payment is processed (CLR-OP-39); the safety-net run skips an invoice already written off by the minimal balance file, so a balance is never reversed twice. Decision requested: Confirm the boundary of 10.00 (OQ11).
* CLR-OP-39 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Minimal balances at processing (CSHID.016; FR-OP-023, 059). Proposed: Minimal balances and minimal excess payments are cleared in the posting of the payment, never routed to Unapplied Payments; the daily run stays as a safety net for balances left by later events. Threshold 10.00 for premium and excess until BDOI confirms; the Adjustment file keeps 10.00 to 100.00. Decision requested: Confirm the threshold values and that a balance of exactly 10.00 is cleared at processing, not written off by the file.

column4: Post the accounting entries of Cashiering
column6:
As a Cashier, I need BIBS to post the accounting entries of every AR and OR, so that receipts and the general ledger always agree.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CSHID.012 (p.98); CSHID.013 (p.98-99); CSHID.014 (p.99)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Cashiering, FR-OP-027 Post the accounting entries of Cashiering
* Persona: System
* Function: Each Cashiering transaction is a business event whose GL rule is configured by Comptrollership: OPS_AR_RECEIPT (AR issued), OPS_AR_INSURANCE_RECEIPT, OPS_OR_ISSUE, OPS_PAYMENT_APPLY, OPS_RECEIPT_REINSTATE, OPS_EXCESS_TO_OVERAGES, OPS_MINIMAL_BALANCE_REVERSAL, OPS_UNAPPLIED_REFUND, OPS_UNAPPLIED_RECLASS. Section 5.3 lists the default entries.

*Business rules*
* (R1) GL accounts are never chosen in code; Comptrollership configures the rules (maker-checker). (Configurable)
* (R2) The bank and cash-on-hand accounts of the @BANK role come from the parameters CASH_BANK_ACCOUNT and CASH_ON_HAND_ACCOUNT. (Configurable)
* (R3) BOOK rate with 2 decimals, maintained on Currency Rates until its source is agreed (OQ08). (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the GL rules of the events are configured (OQ07), when a Cashiering transaction is posted, then Issuing, applying and cancelling an AR produce three balanced journals; the cancellation nets the first two to zero.
* (AC2) Given the GL rules of the events are configured (OQ07) and a USD AR, when a Cashiering transaction is posted, then it posts pesos at the BOOK rate of the receipt date.

column4: Extract remittances in the scheduled run
column6:

* Persona: System (the scheduled remittance extraction); Remittance Processor
* Function: An extraction run REX-yyyy-n examines the invoices of an insurer whose remittance status is UNPROCESSED, WITH_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE or PARTIALLY_REMITTED. It is started by the scheduled job (daily off-peak, 20:00 PHT by default), manually for an insurer and remittance type, or for one invoice number. Each insurer is processed in its own transaction.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The remittance type is WITH_INCENTIVES when an early remittance rule covers the invoice (FR-OP-038), otherwise NORMAL_PHP or NORMAL_USD by currency. (Configurable)
* (R2) Batch numbers RMB-<insurer>-yyyy-n are unique and never reused. (Fixed)
* (R3) Schedule of the job. (Configurable)
* (R4) Extract file naming. (Configurable)
* (R5) An invoice extracted by any source (scheduled, manual, special) is not extracted again by a later run; the source is kept with the tag. (Fixed)
* Check: Invoice of another insurer. Message: "Invoice <no> is not an invoice of <insurer>"
* Check: Invoice not extractable. Message: "Invoice <no> cannot be extracted: remittance status <status>"
* Check: Invoice not eligible now. Message: "Invoice <no> cannot be remitted now: <reasons>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has REMIT_EXTRACT for a manual run, when the job or the processor starts a run for one or all insurers, then the scheduled run extracts a paid and cleared invoice of INS-MGIC into a batch RMB-INS-MGIC-2026-n with tag EXTRACTED and locks it.
* (AC2) Given the user has REMIT_EXTRACT for a manual run and an invoice on hold, when the job or the processor starts a run for one or all insurers, then it is tagged UNEXTRACTED_DUE with reason ON_HOLD.
* (AC4) Given the user has REMIT_EXTRACT for a manual run and an invoice queued for the end of day, when the job or the processor starts a run for one or all insurers, then it is extracted by the evening run, once.

Proposed: An invoice paid by instalment is extracted for the instalments applied and posted, even while the account is "still in process"; "in process" is read as an account with later instalments not yet due or not yet paid. column4: Apply the remittance eligibility rules
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need BIBS to extract only from applied and posted payments, whatever the channel, so that only money really applied is remitted.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.006 (p.115); RMTID.014 (p.119-120); RMTID.015 (p.120); RMTID.017 (p.121-122); RMTID.018 (p.122); RMTID.020 (p.123-124); RMTID.022 (p.124-125); RMTID.028 (p.127); RMTID.031 (p.128-129); RMTID.035 (p.130)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Remittance, FR-OP-031 Apply the remittance eligibility rules
* Persona: System
* Function: Paid AR is the net applied PR of the invoice from applied and posted payments only (cash, check and every channel). The amount to remit is paid AR less the DTIP already remitted.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Holding period 3 banking days on the branch calendar, counted from the last applied value date. (Configurable)
* (R2) Paid AR above DTIP excluded by default; CAP remits the DTIP balance. (Configurable)
* (R3) Negative DTIP is never extracted. (Fixed)
* (R4) The rules are checked again at submission and approval (FR-OP-033, FR-OP-035). (Fixed)
* (R5) Any pending or unresolved financial endorsement blocks the extraction; posted adjustments do not. (Fixed)
* (R6) Instalment invoices are extracted for the instalments applied, even while the account is in process (meaning of in process to confirm, CLR-OP-44). (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and an invoice paid by check two banking days ago, when BIBS reads the ledger balances, flags and payments of the invoice, then it is UNEXTRACTED_DUE with CHECK_HOLDING and is extracted on the third banking day.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS and an invoice with paid AR 10,500.00 and DTIP 10,000.00, when BIBS reads the ledger balances, flags and payments of the invoice, then it is excluded and listed on REM-PAIDAR-OVER-DTIP with invoice, insurer, paid AR and DTIP.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS and a written-off invoice, when BIBS reads the ledger balances, flags and payments of the invoice, then it is never in a batch and shows WRITTEN_OFF on Invoice 360.
* (AC4) Given the step is due in BIBS, when BIBS reads the ledger balances, flags and payments of the invoice, then submitting a negative adjustment on an invoice in a batch notifies the Remittance Team.
* (AC5) Given the step is due in BIBS and an invoice with a pending increase in TSI, when BIBS reads the ledger balances, flags and payments of the invoice, then it is not extracted and its tag reads Pending financial endorsement; once the endorsement is posted the next run extracts it.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-11 - open, for BDOI confirmation: DTIP balance (RMTID.014; FR-OP-031). Proposed: A paid AR above the DTIP balance is excluded from the remittance by default (option Exclude); the option Cap remits the DTIP balance only. Decision requested: Choose Exclude or Cap (OQ19).
* CLR-OP-13 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Cleared checks (RMTID.017; FR-OP-031). Proposed: Checks are counted in banking days from the last applied value date on the branch calendar; the cleared status comes from the payment application. Decision requested: Confirm the counting (OQ20).
* CLR-OP-44 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Instalment invoices in the extraction (RMTID.003; FR-OP-030, 031). Proposed: An invoice paid by instalment is extracted for the instalments applied and posted, even while the account is "still in process"; "in process" is read as an account with later instalments not yet due or not yet paid. Decision requested: Define "still in process" for instalment accounts.

column4: Review a batch and exclude records (addendum)
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need to open the extracted file online and exclude records, without changing any financial value, so that the batch is corrected by exclusion while the amounts stay as computed.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.002 (p.113); RMTID.024 (p.125-126; annex p.15); RMTID.027 (p.127)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Remittance, FR-OP-032 Review a batch and exclude records (addendum)
* Persona: Remittance Processor
* Function: The Remittance Batches screen lists the batches by stage (queues) with insurer, type, processor, counts and totals; it filters by insurer and type and supports bulk submit and approve.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Exclusion only; amounts cannot be changed. (Fixed)
* (R2) Exclusion reasons from the list. (Configurable)
* (R3) Exclusion and restore only while the batch can change. (Fixed)
* Check: Line already excluded. Message: "Invoice <no> is already excluded"
* Check: Restore of a line not excluded. Message: "Invoice <no> is not excluded"
* Check: Restore no longer possible. Message: "Invoice <no> can no longer be restored (remittance status <status>)"
* Check: Batch no longer editable. Message: "Batch <no> is <stage>: lines can no longer change"
* Check: Exclusion without permission. Message: "You are not permitted to perform this action"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has REMIT_EXCLUDE; the batch is in REVIEW_IN_PROCESS or ON_HOLD, when the processor opens the batch and reviews the lines, then the processor cannot change the paid AR or commission of a line.
* (AC2) Given the user has REMIT_EXCLUDE; the batch is in REVIEW_IN_PROCESS or ON_HOLD, when the processor opens the batch and reviews the lines, then excluding a line removes it from the totals and the preview and unlocks the invoice.
* (AC3) Given the user has REMIT_EXCLUDE; the batch is in REVIEW_IN_PROCESS or ON_HOLD and a restored line, when the processor opens the batch and reviews the lines, then it is back in the totals.
* (AC4) Given the user has REMIT_EXCLUDE; the batch is in REVIEW_IN_PROCESS or ON_HOLD, when the processor opens the batch and reviews the lines, then only the remaining lines are posted on approval.
* (AC5) Given the user has REMIT_EXCLUDE; the batch is in REVIEW_IN_PROCESS or ON_HOLD, when the processor opens the batch and reviews the lines, then the list of extracted accounts shows for each account the insurer, policy number, invoice, remittance type and batch number of the remittance schedule.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-05 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Edit of the extracted file (RMTID.002; FR-OP-032). Proposed: Rows of the extract are excluded and restored with a reason; financial fields cannot be edited. Decision requested: Confirm exclusion in place of edits.
* CLR-OP-46 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Columns of the extracted accounts (RMTID.024; FR-OP-032). Proposed: The extracted accounts show the remittance schedule details (insurer, policy number, invoice, assured, remittance type, batch number, amounts); the settlement number is added when its meaning and source are given. Decision requested: Say what the settlement number is and where it comes from.

column4: Process a batch - assign, submit, hold and return
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need extracted accounts transferred to Process Remittance with their status, so that I see where each account is in the remittance process.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.009 (p.117-118); RMTID.010 (p.117); RMTID.019 (p.122-123); RMTID.029 (p.127-128)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Remittance, FR-OP-033 Process a batch - assign, submit, hold and return

column4: Produce the remittance schedule and payment request

* Persona: Remittance Processor
* Function: The remittance schedule (PDF and XLSX) and the payment request (PDF) are generated from the templates REMITTANCE_SCHEDULE and REMITTANCE_PAYMENT_REQUEST and stored on the batch. They show the batch number, insurer, remittance type and the payment details per invoice; the layouts follow Annex III (Normal, Special, With Incentives).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Schedule layouts are drafts until BDOI confirms them (Mall Assurance columns of the Normal schedule, OQ42). (Configurable)

column4: Approve a batch, post the remittance and request payment
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need to submit accounts for remittance processing and approval, so that a second person approves the remittance before it is paid.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.010 (p.117); RMTID.019 (p.122-123)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Remittance, FR-OP-035 Approve a batch, post the remittance and request payment
* Persona: Remittance TL
* Function: The TL approves the submitted batch (Approve and push to Disbursement). In the approval transaction BIBS: re-checks every line; posts OPS_REMITTANCE per line (Dr DTIP, Dr CWT / Cr commission receivable, Cr due to insurer for disbursement); records REMITTED movements on DTIP, commission, VAT and WTAX and sets the invoices APPROVED; for a With Incentives batch posts OPS_REMIT_INCENTIVE; sends a payment request of type REMITTANCE for the payable to Disbursement; and issues the commission OR (and the incentive OR) through Cashiering.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The approver is never the submitter. (Fixed)
* (R2) Posting, the payment request and the ORs happen once per batch; a repeat does not duplicate them. (Fixed)
* Check: Approver is the submitter. Message: "Batch <no> must be approved by another user"
* Check: Line no longer valid. Message: "Batch <no> cannot go on: <problems>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the batch is FOR_APPROVAL; the user has REMIT_APPROVE and did not submit it, when the TL reviews the batch and its preview, then the processor who submitted a batch cannot approve it.
* (AC2) Given the batch is FOR_APPROVAL; the user has REMIT_APPROVE and did not submit it, when the TL reviews the batch and its preview, then Approval posts one balanced OPS_REMITTANCE journal per line and one payment request for the payable.
* (AC3) Given the batch is FOR_APPROVAL; the user has REMIT_APPROVE and did not submit it, when the TL reviews the batch and its preview, then the batch shows the commission OR number issued by Cashiering.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The OR amount is compared with the paid AR of the invoice, exact amount (tolerance to be given, OQ22). (Configurable)
* (R2) An OR number is recorded once per client. (Fixed)
* Check: Batch not approved. Message: "Batch <no> is <stage>: not yet approved"
* Check: Line excluded. Message: "Invoice <no> was excluded from <batch>"
* Check: OR already recorded. Message: "OR <no> was already recorded for client <client>"

* Check: Bad date or amount. Message: "Line <n>: <column> must be a date such as 28-Oct-2026 / an amount"
