column4: Apply the early remittance incentive
column6:
As the Remittance TL / TH, I need the additional incentive for early remittance computed automatically, so that BDOI earns the incentive on every qualifying remittance.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.041 (annex p.16-17); RMTID.023 (p.125)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.3 Remittance, FR-OP-038 Apply the early remittance incentive
* Persona: Remittance TL (rules); System
* Function: An incentive rule holds the insurer, product line (blank = all), segment (blank = all), rate as a percent of basic premium, window in days and the start of the window (inception or booking), with effective dates. An invoice remitted within the window goes into a With Incentives batch; its incentive = rate x basic premium share, with VAT at the invoice's VAT to commission ratio. On approval BIBS posts OPS_REMIT_INCENTIVE (Dr due for disbursement / Cr incentive income, output VAT) and issues the incentive OR.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Rates, windows and basis per insurer and product (proposed default: CLG and CBG motor and fire, 2%, 30 days; start of the window from BDOI, OQ23, CLR-OP-47). (Configurable)
* (R2) The incentive is a separate computation and a separate line; it is never merged with the commission or the remittance amounts. (Fixed)
* (R3) No incentive without a valid remittance date and complete insurer and remittance data. (Fixed)
* Check: End before start. Message: "The rule cannot end before it starts"
* Check: No company. Message: "Choose the company of the rule"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has REMIT_APPROVE to maintain rules, when the TL adds a rule for an insurer, then a CBG motor invoice remitted 20 days after the start of the window is in a With Incentives batch with a 2% incentive shown on its own line; its commission and net due are unchanged.
* (AC2) Given the user has REMIT_APPROVE to maintain rules, when the TL adds a rule for an insurer, then the same invoice remitted after 40 days has no incentive.
* (AC3) Given the user has REMIT_APPROVE to maintain rules and an invoice of a product the rule, when the TL adds a rule for an insurer, then it does not cover (for example CBG marine) has no incentive.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-47 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Early remittance incentive and estimated items moved (RMTID.041, RMTID.037; FR-OP-038, 078, 097). Proposed: Remittance validates and computes the incentive for CLG / CBG motor and fire accounts (2%, window of 30 days from inception by default) as a separate line; Production Reconciliation keeps a read-only check of the incentive the insurer applied (FR-OP-078). Estimated items are flagged by the Production Reconciliation Handler. Decision requested: Confirm the start of the window, whether the reconciliation check of FR-OP-078 stays, and the definition of estimated items.

column4: Detect duplicate endorsement requests
column6:

column4: Validate, approve or return endorsement requests
column6:
As Marketing Collection, I need to receive the requests returned by Operations with their reason, correct them and resubmit them, so that problem requests are fixed by their owner and never posted as they are.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: ADJID.005 (p.154-155; annex p.34-35); MKTID.016 (annex p.35); MKTID.017 (annex p.35-36)

* Persona: Adjustment Processor (validate, return); Adjustment TL (approve)
* Function: Requests follow workflow OPS_ENDORSEMENT (section 5). The processor validates a submitted request for approval or, when it has no financial effect, directly for posting. The TL approves it. Extension of cover with additional premium (FIN_EXTENSION) always needs approval.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The approver never raised, submitted or validated the request. (Fixed)
* (R2) Return reasons from the list; a reason is mandatory for every return (MKTID.016; ADJID.005 allows mandatory or configurable, CLR-OP-52). (Configurable)
* (R3) A returned request goes to the Marketing owner of the account for correction. (Fixed)

* Check: Return without reason. Message: "Select the return reason"
* Check: Action in the wrong stage. Message: "<request> is <stage>, not <expected>"

column4: Recompute premium, commission and refund per insurer (addendum)
column6:
As an Adjustment Processor, I need BIBS to recompute premium, commission, refund premium and sum insured per insurer automatically on submission, from validated inputs, with a service invoice when income or commission changes, so that endorsements are computed correctly and consistently with the posting.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: ADJID.014 (p.158-159; annex p.36-37)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Adjustment / Cancellation, FR-OP-054 Recompute premium, commission and refund per insurer (addendum)
* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS recomputes the premium, commission, refund premium and sum insured by request type. Cancellations use booking's own posting preview, so the preview equals the posting. A TSI change is rated once per insurer share with the catalogue calculator in endorsement mode (remaining term pro-rata or short-period, each insurer at its commission rate, the lead with its branch LGT). Other types take the entered component changes (commission derived from the invoice rate when blank).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Refund basis pro-rata or short-period, chosen per request (OQ36). (Configurable)
* (R2) Service invoice on an income or commission change; credit of the insurer's service invoice on a decrease (OQ34). (Fixed)
* (R3) Before, Change and After are shown on one basis, the premium in force of the policy year: the invoice with the endorsements and returns of the same policy year (CLR-OP-35), so a flat cancellation of a policy with later endorsements takes the whole policy year back to zero and never shows a negative After.

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the request has its type and changes and a decrease in TSI of a 60/40 co-insured invoice, when the user enters the request, then it shows the premium and commission change per insurer.
* (AC2) Given the request has its type and changes and a commission increase without premium change, when the user enters the request, then it issues a service invoice at posting.
* (AC3) Given the request has its type and changes, when the user enters the request, then the recompute of a flat cancellation equals the amounts posted by booking.
* (AC4) Given the request has its type and changes and a flat cancellation of a policy with a later endorsement, when the user enters the request, then it shows Before as the premium in force of the policy year and After as zero for every component.
* (AC5) Given the request has its type and changes and a TSI change submitted without an effective date, when the user enters the request, then it is refused and nothing is recomputed or stored.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-35 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Basis of the recompute (ADJID.014; FR-OP-054). Proposed: Before, Change and After of a request are all taken on the premium in force of the policy year: the invoice with the endorsements and returns of the same policy year, as booking computes a cancellation. A flat cancellation of a policy with later endorsements therefore shows the whole policy year going to zero; a write-off or a non-financial request stays on the invoice alone. Decision requested: Confirm the premium in force of the policy year as the basis.

column4: Handle a TSI increase above the package limit

column4: Set up excess payments, re-apply payments and AR Insurer
column6:
As an Adjustment Processor, I need on a decrease of TSI, to apply the excess payment to another invoice or refund it, so that the client's money is never left unapplied after a decrease.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: ADJID.009 (p.156-157); ADJID.012 (p.157-158); ADJID.013 (p.158)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Adjustment / Cancellation, FR-OP-057 Set up excess payments, re-apply payments and AR Insurer
* Persona: System; Adjustment Processor
* Function: After a decrease or cancellation of a paid invoice, BIBS releases the lock and asks Cashiering to re-apply the payments against the reduced premium. Cashiering reverses the applications above the new premium and applies the money again in hierarchy order; the excess becomes one unapplied item (origin REAPPLY) for disposition by Marketing and Cashiering (apply to another invoice or refund, FR-OP-022). Realised commission is reversed with the applications.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Re-application happens once per request and invoice; a repeat does not duplicate it. (Fixed)
* (R2) AR Insurer never exceeds the DTIP remitted. (Fixed)
* Check: Re-application unavailable. Message: "Payments can only be re-applied once Cashiering is available; the request stays awaiting re-application"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a decrease or cancellation is posted on a paid or remitted invoice, when BIBS posts the request (FR-OP-056), then cancelling a fully paid, not remitted invoice of 10,000.00 creates an unapplied item of 10,000.00.

column4: Control over-adjustment and capture justifications
column6:
As an Adjustment Processor, I need a baseline for allowable adjustments, tracking of cumulative adjustments and a prompt above the baseline or on a negative balance, so that over-adjustment is prevented.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: ADJID.023 (p.162; annex p.37-38 and 40); ADJID.028 (p.166)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Adjustment / Cancellation, FR-OP-058 Control over-adjustment and capture justifications
* Persona: System; requester
* Function: BIBS keeps the cumulative adjustments of each original invoice against its original premium, DTIP and commission. Previous adjustments of the invoice are shown on the request before it is submitted; duplicates are flagged or blocked by FR-OP-051.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Cumulative baseline 100% of the original premium and of the original DTIP (default, OQ37). (Configurable)
* (R2) Baseline limit per adjustment and warning level (proposed 90%): values from BDOI (CLR-OP-53). (Configurable)
* (R3) Justification required for the four breaches of the annex; none for a standard adjustment. (Fixed)
* Check: Above the baseline without justification. Message: "Cumulative adjustments of <amount> exceed the baseline of <n>% of the original premium <amount>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and a second premium increase that takes the adjustments above 100% of the original premium, when the user submits a request, then it needs a justification.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the user submits a request, then a decrease that would make the premium negative is refused without justification.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS and a request that takes the cumulative adjustments to 92% of the original premium, when the user submits a request, then it shows the warning and can be submitted without justification.
* (AC4) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the user submits a request, then a request whose cumulative decrease exceeds the original DTIP needs a justification.

Decision requested: Give the limit per adjustment and the warning level.

column4: Write off minimal balances from a file
column6:
As an Adjustment Processor, I need to process a file of accounts with minimal balances from 10.00 to 100.00, so that small balances are written off or credited in one run.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: ADJID.026 (p.164-165)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Adjustment / Cancellation, FR-OP-059 Write off minimal balances from a file
* Persona: Adjustment Processor (ADJ_POST)
* Function: The processor uploads a file of invoices with minimal balances (columns Invoice No and Balance). A row is processed when the invoice exists, its PR balance equals the file, lies within 10.00-100.00, was not written off and no other module locks it. A debit balance is written off and a credit balance credited (outcomes WRITE_OFF / CREDIT) with the event OPS_WRITE_OFF, a WRITE_OFF movement and the WRITTEN_OFF flag, once per invoice. The run lists the rows not processed with their reason; ADJ-MINBAL-FILE summarises the file.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Range 10.00-100.00 (OQ11). (Configurable)
* (R2) An invoice is written off once. (Fixed)
* Check: Balance outside range. Message: "<invoice> has a balance of <amount>, outside the file range"
* Check: No PR balance. Message: "<invoice> has no premium receivable balance"
* Check: Invoice locked. Message: "Invoice <no> is locked by <owner>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has ADJ_POST and a balance of 50.00 in the file, when the processor uploads the file, then it is written off and Remittance then refuses the invoice as WRITTEN_OFF.
* (AC2) Given the user has ADJ_POST and a balance of 150.00, when the processor uploads the file, then it is refused with ADJ_BALANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-09 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Minimal balances (CSHID.016, ADJID.026; FR-OP-023, 059). Proposed: Minimal balances are cleared when the payment is processed (CLR-OP-39); the safety-net run skips an invoice already written off by the minimal balance file, so a balance is never reversed twice. Decision requested: Confirm the boundary of 10.00 (OQ11).
* CLR-OP-39 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Minimal balances at processing (CSHID.016; FR-OP-023, 059). Proposed: Minimal balances and minimal excess payments are cleared in the posting of the payment, never routed to Unapplied Payments; the daily run stays as a safety net for balances left by later events. Threshold 10.00 for premium and excess until BDOI confirms; the Adjustment file keeps 10.00 to 100.00. Decision requested: Confirm the threshold values and that a balance of exactly 10.00 is cleared at processing, not written off by the file.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CMRID.001 (p.169; annex p.46)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Commission Receivables / Direct Payment, FR-OP-090 Take in the DP entries from the system tagging
* Persona: System; Commission Handler
* Function: Every invoice tagged direct payment at quotation or policy (MKTID.011) whose DP tagging is confirmed by Marketing Collection (MKTID.012, the Collections disposition DP PR for reversal of BRD-4) flows into Commission Receivables as a DP account DPL-yyyy-n, with no file to upload: the system tagging is the single source of the DP entries (Commission Receivables annex, p.43). The DP entries of Head Office and of each branch are consolidated with de-duplication by invoice and become the basis of billing.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The DP tag of the booking and the confirmation of Marketing Collection are the source of the DP entries. (Fixed)
* (R2) An invoice already active as a DP account is a duplicate. (Fixed)
* (R3) Fallback upload naming <Branch>_DP_<yyyyMMdd>, for example HO_DP_20260930.xlsx, until withdrawn (CLR-OP-54). (Fixed)
* Check: Name not in the convention. Message: "Name the DP list <Branch>_DP_<yyyyMMdd> (e.g. HO_DP_20260930.xlsx): <file>"
* Check: Date part not a date. Message: "The date in <file> is not a date (yyyyMMdd)"
* Check: Same file again. Message: "<file> was already taken in as <list no>"
* Check: No invoice column. Message: "The DP list has no '<column>' column"
* Check: Row without invoice. Message: "The row has no invoice number"
* Check: Premium not an amount. Message: "Premium '<value>' is not an amount"
* Check: No invoice of the list booked. Message: "No invoice of the list is booked: upload it from Commission Receivables"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the invoice is booked and tagged direct payment; for the fallback upload the user has COMMREC_PROCESS and a direct payment invoice confirmed by Marketing Collection, when marketing Collection confirms the DP tagging of an invoice, then it appears as a DP account without any upload.
* (AC2) Given the invoice is booked and tagged direct payment; for the fallback upload the user has COMMREC_PROCESS, when marketing Collection confirms the DP tagging of an invoice, then the same invoice confirmed twice gives one DP account.

column4: Review DP entries read-only, exclude by rule and confirm eligibility from the fully paid status
column6:
As a Commission Handler / Processor, I need to view each DP entry read-only at invoice level with its production record, commission history, remittance status and commission status, so that I can check the entries without the system changing or reconciling them.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CMRID.002 (p.169-170; annex p.46-48); CMRID.003 (p.170; annex p.48-50); CMRID.007 (p.172; annex p.54-55); CMRID.008 (p.172-173; annex p.55-57); CMRID.013 (p.175; annex p.59-61)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Commission Receivables / Direct Payment, FR-OP-091 Review DP entries read-only, exclude by rule and confirm eligibility from the fully paid status
* Persona: System; Commission Handler
* Function: Read-only review (CMRID.002): each DP account is shown at invoice level with its production record, the history of its commission movements and adjustments (for example endorsements that changed the premium or the commission), the premium remittance status (fully paid or not fully paid), the commission status (paid or unpaid) and the key fields (policy number, invoice amount, insurer, branch). Everything is read-only: the review does not validate, reconcile, match, compute or correct anything. BIBS highlights what the user can see is inconsistent (missing data, a duplicate entry, a status that differs from what is expected, for example unpaid but expected paid) as flags on the account, without applying a validation rule.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only Valid accounts (eligible from the fully paid status and not excluded) are billed. (Fixed)
* (R2) Exclusion rules Negative amount and Fully cancelled; others from the annex of criteria (CLR-OP-56). (Configurable)
* (R3) The review is read-only; no user exclusion or manual payment confirmation. (Fixed)
* (R4) Source of the fully paid status: the payment status of the invoice ledger (CLR-OP-62). (Fixed)
* Check: Action on an account in another status. Message: "Account <invoice> (<tag>) cannot be <action>"
* Check: Account already in the target status. Message: "Account <invoice> is already <tag>"

*Acceptance criteria*

* (AC2) Given the user has COMMREC_PROCESS to work the accounts; OPS_VIEW to view them and an account with a negative amount, when BIBS takes the DP account (FR-OP-090) and applies the exclusion rules, then it is Invalid with the rule Negative amount, stays visible and is not billed.

* Persona: Commission Handler
* Function: The handler prepares billings from the Valid accounts: one billing CRB-yyyy-n per insurer, assigned to the handler (workflow OPS_DP_BILLING, section 5). * Persona: Commission Handler; System (the daily feedback follow-up)
* Function: The insurer approves or rejects each account. Answers are entered on the billing or uploaded (columns Billing No., Invoice No., Decision, Reason, Comment). A rejection needs a reason from DP_FEEDBACK_REASON before it is final. Approved accounts stay Valid and go to collection; rejected accounts become Invalid, or Returned when they are sent back for correction or review, and are returned to the Collection team through the COLLECTION_DP_RETURNED extract with the time and reason. * Check: Billing not waiting. Message: "Billing <no> is not waiting for the insurer"
* Check: Invoice not on the billing. Message: "Invoice <no> is not on billing <no>"
* Check: Unknown billing in the file. Message: "Billing <no> does not exist"
* Check: Decision not Approved or Rejected. Message: "Decision '<value>' is not one of Approved or Rejected (or Yes / No)"
* Check: Column missing. Message: "The insurer's answer has no '<column>' column"

column4: Collect DP commission and reverse the premium receivable
column6:

* Persona: Commission Handler; System
* Function: When the insurer pays the commission of an approved billing, the handler records the collection with the bank account, collection date and BIR certificate number. BIBS posts OPS_DP_COMMISSION_COLLECT (cash and CWT against the commission receivable; realisation of commission and output VAT), requests the commission OR from Cashiering and, for each approved account, records the DP_REVERSAL of the premium receivable and DTIP and the APPLIED commission. The billing moves to COLLECTED and then CLOSED.

column4: Compute and post SLA-based incentives per invoice
column6:
As the Commission TL / TH, I need incentive eligibility and amounts computed per invoice from each insurer's SLA criteria, rates and multipliers, so that incentives follow the insurer agreements and never production targets.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: CMRID.005 (p.171-172; annex p.52-53); CMRID.006 (p.172; annex p.53-54); CMRID.003 (p.170; annex p.48-50)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Commission Receivables / Direct Payment, FR-OP-095 Compute and post SLA-based incentives per invoice
* Persona: Commission TL (INCENTIVE_MANAGE, COMMREC_APPROVE)
* Function: An incentive programme (scheme) is defined by configurable parameters taken from the insurer's Service Level Agreement or programme set-up, never by a programme name fixed in the system (CMRID.005 and CMRID.006 as revised by the Commission Receivables annex): the insurer, the programme type (a list maintained by the business; the v2.0 names No Touch, Top Up and Motor Mania become entries of that list), the eligibility criteria (product, period, branch, marketing unit, minimum premium and the other SLA conditions), the structure (a rate with its multiplier, or a fixed amount or configured value per policy or invoice), the beneficiary and the effective dates.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Programmes are inactive until BDOI gives the SLA rates, amounts, multipliers, credit terms and criteria (OQ39, CLR-OP-58). (Configurable)
* (R2) Exclusion rules Negative amount and Fully cancelled (the v2.0 rule erroneous booking is renamed Fully cancelled; CLR-OP-56). (Configurable)
* (R3) Eligibility needs fully paid status and payment within the credit term; no production target. (Fixed)
* (R4) Programme types are a configurable list; no programme is fixed in the system. (Configurable)
* Check: Scheme without tiers. Message: "Scheme <name> has no tiers yet: add its targets and amounts first"
* Check: Tier incomplete (tiered). Message: "Each tier needs a production target and a rate above zero"
* Check: Tier incomplete (fixed). Message: "Each tier needs a minimum basic premium and a fixed amount above zero"
* Check: Scheme dates. Message: "The scheme ends before it starts"
* Check: Run period. Message: "The period ends before it starts"
* Check: Run earned nothing. Message: "Run <no> earned no incentive to post"
* Check: Run already posted or cancelled. Message: "Run <no> is <status> and cannot change"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the scheme has tiers, when the TL maintains the scheme and its tiers, then a programme paying a fixed 1,000.00 per motor policy of basic premium 50,000.00 or more, for branch CEB, pays 1,000.00 for a fully paid CEB policy of 60,000.00 paid within the credit term, and nothing for the same policy of another branch.
* (AC2) Given the scheme has tiers, when the TL maintains the scheme and its tiers, then an invoice that meets the criteria but was paid after the credit term, or is not fully paid, gets no incentive.
* (AC3) Given the scheme has tiers and a fully cancelled invoice, when the TL maintains the scheme and its tiers, then it is excluded from a run and listed with the rule Fully cancelled.
* (AC4) Given the scheme has tiers, when the TL maintains the scheme and its tiers, then the run lists every computed incentive per invoice with its programme and rate or amount.

* CLR-OP-24 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Incentive schemes (CMRID.005, 006; FR-OP-095). Proposed: Superseded by CLR-OP-58: the incentives follow each insurer's SLA per invoice; the programmes stay inactive until BDOI gives the SLA parameters. Decision requested: See CLR-OP-58.

Proposed: Rules Negative amount and Fully cancelled (the v2.0 rule "erroneous booking" is renamed); the handler's manual exclusion with a reason is withdrawn; other rules are added from BDOI's annex of criteria. Decision requested: Provide the annex of exclusion criteria; confirm the withdrawal of the manual exclusion.

column4: Age commission receivables by invoice
column6:

* Function: BIBS ages the outstanding commission receivable of each billed invoice from its reference date: the billing date, or the Statement of Account date when the receivable was billed through a statement (CMRID.011 as revised by the Commission Receivables annex). *Business rules*

* Persona: Marketing Collection (request); Marketing TL / UH (approve); System (expiry)
* Function: Marketing raises a hold request HLD-yyyy-n on an invoice with a reason, hold-until date and remarks, singly or by file (invoiceNo, reasonCode, holdUntil, remarks). One live request per invoice. Submission makes the invoice REQUESTED_FOR_HOLD; approval by another user sets the HOLD flag, which excludes the invoice from extraction (FR-OP-031). * (R1) Only invoices UNPROCESSED, WITH_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE or PARTIALLY_REMITTED, not direct payment, can be held. (Fixed)
* (R2) The approver is never the requester. (Fixed)
* (R3) Hold reasons (values from BDOI, OQ24); no maximum hold period. (Configurable)

* Check: Hold already open. Message: "Invoice <no> already has hold <no>"
* Check: Date not in the future. Message: "The hold-until date must be in the future"
* Check: Extension not later. Message: "The extension must be later than <date>"
* Check: Approver is the requester. Message: "Hold <no> must be approved by another user"
* Check: Assignee not a processor. Message: "<user> is not an active remittance processor"
* Check: Action in another stage. Message: "Hold <no> is <stage>, not <expected>"

* (AC3) Given the user has HOLD_REQUEST (request) or HOLD_APPROVE (decide, assign) and a hold whose date passed is released by the job and the invoice, when marketing creates the hold request and submits it, then it is extracted by the next run.

column4: Tag PR 2307 reversals and check them against the computed amount
column6:
As Marketing Collection, I need to tag and track BIR 2307 certificates, check whether the payment was already remitted and whether a commission receivable is outstanding, and log every action, so that the PR 2307 reversal is correct, and a remitted payment or an unpaid commission is handled, not missed.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: MKTID.013 (p.107-108); MKTID.010 (p.137-138; annex p.62-63)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.7 Marketing Collection items, FR-OP-113 Tag, validate and post PR 2307 reversals and route the certificates to Disbursement
* Persona: Marketing Collection (tag, validate, post and route); System (computations and checks)
* Function: Marketing Collection owns the whole PR 2307 reversal (MKTID.013 of BRD v1.01; the Cashiering steps of CSHID.026 and 027 are deleted). Marketing tags the reversal of an invoice with the BIR 2307 certificate received from the client: certificate number and period and the certificate amount, singly or by file. BIBS generates and stores the reference CWT-yyyy-n at tagging.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One tag in process per invoice. (Fixed)
* (R2) A 2307 report and batch hold the certificates of one insurer. (Fixed)
* (R3) Certificate amount <= computed PR 2307 amount and <= outstanding PR balance. (Fixed)
* (R4) Withholding tax rate and base of the PR 2307 computation (default 2% of the premium subject to withholding). (Configurable)
* (R5) Accounting entry of the reversal: proposed Dr DTIP / Cr PR at posting and no entry at release (CLR-OP-41). (Configurable)
* (R6) A payment already remitted goes to Unapplied Payments only with the insurer's written confirmation of refund. (Fixed)
* Check: Unknown invoice. Message: "Unknown invoice <no>"
* Check: Tag already in process. Message: "Invoice <no> already has a 2307 tag in process"
* Check: No 2% outstanding. Message: "Invoice <no> has no 2% CWT portion outstanding"
* Check: Certificate path without number. Message: "A certificate tag needs the BIR 2307 certificate number"
* Check: Certificate amount above the computed PR 2307 amount or the outstanding PR. Message: "<ref>: the certificate amount <amount> is above the allowable PR 2307 amount <amount> or the outstanding premium receivable <amount>"
* Check: Tags of several insurers. Message: "A 2307 batch holds the certificates of one insurer"
* Check: No selection. Message: "Select the 2307 tags to validate"
* Check: Remitted payment without the insurer's confirmation. Message: "Attach the insurer's written confirmation that the excess will be refunded"
* Check: Batch already routed. Message: "<batch> is <status>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has the 2307 tagging and processing permissions of Marketing Collection; the invoice has a 2% CWT portion outstanding and a certificate tag, when marketing enters the invoice, certificate number, period and amount; BIBS issues the reference CWT-yyyy-n, then it receives a reference CWT-2026-n and shows the computed PR 2307 amount, the outstanding PR and the CRU status.
* (AC2) Given the user has the 2307 tagging and processing permissions of Marketing Collection; the invoice has a 2% CWT portion outstanding and a certificate amount above the computed PR 2307 amount, when marketing enters the invoice, certificate number, period and amount; BIBS issues the reference CWT-yyyy-n, then it is refused; so is an amount above the outstanding PR.
* (AC7) Given the user has the 2307 tagging and processing permissions of Marketing Collection; the invoice has a 2% CWT portion outstanding and a second tag on the same invoice, when marketing enters the invoice, certificate number, period and amount; BIBS issues the reference CWT-yyyy-n, then it is refused while the first is in process.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-40 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Owner of the PR 2307 reversal (MKTID.013; CSHID.026, 027 deleted; FR-OP-026, 113, 121). Proposed: Marketing Collection tags, validates against the certificates, generates and posts the BIR 2307 transaction report and routes it to Disbursement; the Cashier's 2307 right moves to Marketing Collection. The cash payment of the 2% by a client is received by Cashiering as an ordinary payment applied to the withheld portion, without a 2307 tag (the Settle in Cash step of v2.0 is withdrawn). The screens of chapter 13 show the v2.0 layout and are updated with this change. Decision requested: Confirm Marketing Collection as owner of every step and the handling of a 2% paid in cash.
* CLR-OP-41 - open, for BDOI confirmation: PR 2307 accounting entries (MKTID.013; DBMID.001; FR-OP-113, 121; section 5.3). Proposed: One entry when Marketing Collection posts the reversal: Dr DTIP / Cr PR by component; no entry when Disbursement releases the certificates. The v2.0 two-step entries (Dr PR2307 / Cr PR, then Dr DTIP / Cr PR2307) are withdrawn. Decision requested: Comptrollership confirms the entry, together with the owners of BRD-4 and BRD-5.
* CLR-OP-42 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Outstanding commission receivable (CRU) in the PR 2307 reversal (MKTID.010, 013; FR-OP-113, 094). Proposed: CRU means a commission receivable of BDOI still unpaid on the same invoice or account (a DP commission billed or not yet collected). When one exists, the reversal and release continue, the tag is flagged For Commission Receivable and listed for the Commission Receivables team. Decision requested: Confirm the definition of the CRU and the follow-up by Commission Receivables.
* CLR-OP-43 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Allowable PR 2307 amount and remitted payments (MKTID.010, 013; FR-OP-113). Proposed: The allowable PR 2307 amount is the client's withholding rate (2% by default) times the premium subject to creditable withholding tax of the invoice, from the withholding tax rules maintained by Comptrollership. When the payment was already remitted, the reversed amount goes to Unapplied Payments with the insurer's written confirmation of refund attached; no reinstatement request is raised and nothing is routed to Adjustment. Decision requested: Confirm the computation basis (premium, charges included or not) and the Unapplied route.
* Part 1 of 2 of FR-OP-113; the other part: Validate and post PR 2307 reversals and route the certificates to Disbursement.

Disbursement acknowledges a request, enters the DV number, marks it paid, or returns it with a reason. Each status (SENT, ACKNOWLEDGED, DV_ASSIGNED, PAID, RETURNED, CANCELLED) is sent back to the source module (Disbursement status event): Remittance updates the invoices (FR-OP-036), Cashiering completes the refund. *Business rules*
* (R1) Roles are granted permissions as in section 3.3 until BDOI confirms the matrix (OQ48). (Configurable)
* (R2) A user may hold several roles. The BRD rule of one role per user (NFR 3.04) is not applied (decision D5; chapter 21, CLR-CL-18). (Fixed)
* (R3) Lock-out after LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS consecutive failed log-ins (default 3). (Configurable)
* (R4) BDO single sign-on with Windows credentials (NFR 1.01) is not part of this phase (Q42). (Fixed)
* (R5) Collections roles view Remittance and the Production Register of Operations and change nothing there; no new user profile is created (minutes p.1; CLR-CL-37). (Configurable)

* (AC4) Given the user is logged in, when the user opens a Collections screen or starts an action, then a user is locked after three consecutive wrong passwords; the correct password is then refused with the same message as a wrong password, and Users shows the lock to the System Administrator.

*Business rules*

* (R5) Collections roles view Remittance and the Production Register of Operations and change nothing there; no new user profile is created (minutes p.1; CLR-CL-37). (Configurable)

column4: Handle commission refunds from negative adjustments apart; bill only the collectible commission on mixed payments
column6:
As the Commission Receivables Unit, I need refunds from negative adjustments computed and handled apart from collectible commission, so that they are never chased as receivables.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.063 (p.12-13, draft); Minutes of 27-Apr-2026 on BRD 63 (p.1); BRCLXN.064 (p.13-14, draft); Minutes of 27-Apr-2026 on BRD 64 (p.1)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.10 Commission receivable and incentives, FR-CL-093 Handle commission refunds from negative adjustments apart, FR-CL-094 Bill only the collectible commission on mixed payments
* Persona: System; Commission Receivables Unit
* Function: When a negative adjustment reduces the premium of an invoice whose commission is billed or collected, BIBS would recompute the commission on the final premium and create a commission refund linked to the original commission and the adjustment. Refunds would never be CR-collectible, would be excluded from the CR statement of account, and would be excluded from the CRU dashboards and aging; they stay traceable to the original commission entries (minutes p.1). Their retention follows the archiving criteria asked under CQ26.

*Business rules*
* (R1) A refund is never a CR line. (Fixed)
* (R1) Collectible CR = commission x confirmed direct portion / gross premium. (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given BDOI confirms the draft row (CQ01) and a negative endorsement on a collected commission, when Adjustment posts the commission delta (BRD-2), then it creates a refund, not a negative CR line.

column4: Validate entries and refuse errors
column6:
As a GL Officer (FRBS Processor), I need to prevent posting transactions with errors, so that unbalanced or invalid entries never reach the books.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: FRBS 2.5.4 (p.57); FRBS 2.5.5 (p.58); FRBS 2.8.4 (p.62); FRBS 3.6.0b (p.67)
* FRS: FRS BRD-05 Accounting Disbursement ACSL v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-05_Accounting_Disbursement_ACSL_v2.1.docx), section 4.4 Posting and manual entries, FR-AC-034 Validate entries and refuse errors
* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS validates every manual journal on submission and again on posting. It refuses a journal that has no debit or no credit line, is not balanced, posts to a non-postable, frozen or closed account, uses a currency or branch the account does not allow, is dated outside the permitted window, or would leave a BLOCK account with a negative balance. WARN accounts give a warning that the user sees before confirming. All errors are listed together.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Each account has a negative-balance policy ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK; the natural side comes from the account class. (Configurable)
* (R2) The accounts that may never be negative are to be named by BDOI (AQ30). (Configurable)
* Check: Unbalanced journal. Message: "Journal is not balanced - debit <x> vs credit <y>"
* Check: Any line error. Message: "<list of errors>"
* Check: Negative balance on a BLOCK account. Message: "Account <code> would have a negative (<side>) balance of <amount>"
* Check: Negative balance on a WARN account. Message: "Account <code> would have a negative (<side>) balance of <amount>"
* Check: Value date outside the window. Message: "Value date <date> is earlier / later than the permitted <n> back- / forward-dated days"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a journal is submitted or approved and a journal with debits of 1,000.00 and credits of 900.00, when the user submits or approves a journal, then it is refused as unbalanced.
* (AC2) Given a journal is submitted or approved, when the user submits or approves a journal, then a journal that would make a BLOCK cash account negative is refused; on a WARN account it shows a warning and can be confirmed.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-AC-03 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Negative balances (FRBS 2.5.4, 2.8.4; FR-AC-034). Proposed: Each account has a policy ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK; only BLOCK accounts refuse the journal. Decision requested: Name the accounts that may never be negative (AQ30).

column4: Schedule and run the month-end close of the GL books
column6:
As a GL Team Lead, I need to perform month-end closing of previous month GL books every 2nd banking day of the current month, so that the GL books close on the agreed date.

*Background*

* Persona: GL Team Lead / Head (GL_CLOSE_SCHEDULE); System
* Function: FRBS schedules the close of the previous month's GL books on a date and time of its choice in the current month (Addendum 1). BIBS proposes the 2nd banking day of the month at 17:00 Manila, skipping company holidays. Every 15 minutes the job GL_PERIOD_CLOSE runs the closes that are due - the period-end checklist, then the period close. A refused close is recorded on the schedule with the blocking items and raises GL_CLOSE_FAILED. FRBS can also close at once.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only the previous month may be closed (CLOSE_ONLY_PREVIOUS_MONTH = true). (Configurable)
* (R2) Proposed close - 2nd banking day of the next month, 17:00 Manila. (Fixed)
* (R3) The checklist covers pending journals, reconciliations, FX revaluation and the trial balance. (Fixed)

* Check: Already scheduled. Message: "<period> already has a scheduled close"
* Check: Period not closable. Message: "<period> is <status>"
* Check: Checklist blocking items. Message: "<blocking items>"
* Check: Schedule not active. Message: "The scheduled close is already <status>"

column4: Revalue USD balances at the revaluation rate

column4: Compute, approve and pay the service fee
column6:
As a GL Officer (FRBS Processor), I need to monitor Service Fee, so that referrers are paid their service fee correctly.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: FRBS 2.10.0 (p.62); Appendix A VI (p.145)
* FRS: FRS BRD-05 Accounting Disbursement ACSL v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-05_Accounting_Disbursement_ACSL_v2.1.docx), section 4.7 Service fee, FR-AC-052 Compute, approve and pay the service fee
* Persona: GL Officer (compute, submit); GL Team Lead / Head (approve)
* Function: The service fee is the referrers' share of the commission that BDOI has fully collected - 2.5% or 1% of the commission net of the insurer's withholding tax, per market segment (p.145). FRBS computes a run for a period - BIBS takes the invoices whose payment status became paid in the period, are not cancelled, carry commission and are in no live run, and applies the rule of their segment in force on the day paid. It groups them into one line per service-fee segment, sales unit and currency. The payee of a line is the unit's recipient, else the unit; the cost centre is the recipient's, else the unit's, else the invoice's, else the cost-centre rules.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Proposed rules - CBG 2.5% (segments CBG, RETAIL); IBG 1% (COMBANK, CORBANK, INSTITUTIONAL); base = commission less the insurer's withholding tax. To be confirmed (AQ20). (Configurable)
* (R2) An invoice is in one live run only. (Fixed)
* (R3) Fee = (commission - insurer WTAX) x rate, 2 decimals; USD lines at the BOOK rate. (Fixed)
* (R4) The approver is neither the preparer nor the submitter. (Fixed)
* Check: Period invalid. Message: "Give a period that ends on or before today and after it starts"
* Check: Nothing to pay. Message: "No invoice fully paid from <from> to <to> is left for a service fee"
* Check: Run without invoices. Message: "Run <no> has no invoice to pay a fee on"
* Check: Approver is the preparer. Message: "The run is approved by someone other than its preparer"
* Check: Wrong stage. Message: "Run <no> is <stage> and cannot be <action>"
* Check: Rule incomplete. Message: "Give the segment, the rate and the start date"
* Check: Rate not positive. Message: "The rate is a percentage above 0"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given Rules exist for the segments; the user has SERVICE_FEE_MANAGE (compute) or SERVICE_FEE_APPROVE (approve), when the officer opens Service Fee Runs, enters the fully-paid period and clicks Compute, then for a CBG invoice fully paid in August with commission 10,000.00 and insurer WTAX 200.00, the fee is 245.00.

* Persona: Comptrollership (rules); System
* Function: Accounts can require a cost centre. Comptrollership maintains cost-centre rules - source module, event type, sales unit, account officer - that give the cost centre of an entry. Before posting, the accounting engine fills a missing cost centre on a cost-centre-required line from the first matching rule. column4: Produce the BIR returns, alphalists, SAWT and books of accounts
column6:

*Background*

* Persona: FRBS users (TAX_VIEW)
* Function: FRBS chooses a period and opens or exports each output - the VAT return 2550-Q with the relief lists, 1601-EQ and the quarterly, monthly and annual alphalists (QAP, MAP, 1604-E) from the withholding-tax worksheet, the SAWT from the register of certificates received (FR-DS-057), the 0619-F, 1603, 1702-Q (year to date) and 1702 worksheets from ledger movements of account prefixes and rates from parameters, the BIR books of accounts (general, purchase and sales journals, cash receipts and disbursements books, general ledger per account class with the balance forward) and the Insurance Commission Broker's Annual Statement of Business Operations.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Rates - income tax TAX_RCIT_RATE 25%, fringe benefit TAX_FBT_RATE 35%. (Configurable)
* (R2) The outputs are worksheets and loose-leaf books, not eFPS, DAT or CAS files; the final withholding tax account of 0619-F is not mapped (AQ07). (Fixed)
* (R3) HDMF, SSS, PhilHealth, 1601-C and 1604-C are payroll outputs and out of scope (AQ06); 2550-M only if BDOI still needs it (AQ07). (Fixed)

* Check: Form prepared outside BIBS. Message: "This form is prepared outside BIBS and has no worksheet"
* Check: Period end before start. Message: "Tax period end precedes its start"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has TAX_VIEW (granted to the FRBS roles), when the user opens BIR Forms & Books, chooses the period and the output, then the SAWT of Q3 lists every insurer certificate recorded for the quarter.
* (AC2) Given the user has TAX_VIEW (granted to the FRBS roles), when the user opens BIR Forms & Books, chooses the period and the output, then the Cash Disbursements book of August lists the payment journals of the month.

As a Business Administrator, I need to maintain LOVs, so that lists of values change only with approval.

* Persona: Business Administrator (LOV_MANAGE); approver (MASTER_AUTHORIZE)
* Function: The Business Administrator views every list of values, adds values, edits them and deactivates them by an effective-to date. Each value has an effective-from and effective-to date. Additions and changes wait for approval by another user and apply from their effective date. The lists of BRD-5 are in section 9.3.

column4: Manage users and role profiles through approved requests
column6:
As a System Administrator, I need to manage users of the system, so that users and role profiles change only through approved requests.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BASAU 2.3.0 (p.130); BASAU 2.3.1 (p.130); BASAU 2.3.2 (p.130); BASAU 2.3.3 (p.130); BASAU 2.4.0 (p.131); BASAU 2.4.2 (p.131)

* Persona: System Administrator / Business Administrator (ACCESS_REQUEST); approver (ACCESS_APPROVE)
* Function: User management follows the access matrix and goes through requests - create a user with roles, change the roles of a user (the group profiles), disable a user, and change the permissions of a role. The administrator raises the request with its justification; an approver who is not the requester decides it; BIBS applies it. The request list shows every request with its status. Roles act as the group profiles; a user may hold several roles.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One pending request per subject. (Fixed)
* (R2) A role-permission change applies the difference between the role at approval and the request. (Fixed)

* Check: User exists. Message: "User <user> already exists"
* Check: No role. Message: "Select at least one role"
* Check: Unknown role or permission. Message: "Unknown role(s) / permission(s) <list>"
* Check: Permission added and removed. Message: "Permission(s) both added and removed - <list>"
* Check: No change. Message: "The request does not change the permissions of role <role>"
* Check: Pending request exists. Message: "A request for <subject> is already waiting for approval"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the requester has ACCESS_REQUEST and a request to give glofficer the role FRBS_TL, when the administrator opens Access Requests and creates a request of the needed type, then it takes effect only after another user approves it.

column4: Approve, decline or return administration requests
column6:
As a System Administrator, I need to receive notification on approved/declined/returned requests, so that administration requests are decided with a trail.

*Background*

* Persona: Approver (ACCESS_APPROVE, MASTER_AUTHORIZE)
* Function: The approver sees the pending LOV and user-management requests in My Approvals with a count, and is notified of new ones. The approver approves or declines a request with remarks, or returns it to the requester with remarks; the requester corrects and resubmits it. Several requests can be approved at once through bulk approval - each is decided on its own; a new-user request is approved on its own because its temporary password is shown once.

*Business rules*
* (R1) A request is never decided by its submitter. (Fixed)
* (R2) Remarks are mandatory to decline or return. (Fixed)
* Check: Approver is the requester. Message: "A request cannot be decided by the user who submitted it"
* Check: Decline without reason. Message: "Enter the reason of the rejection"
* Check: Return without remarks. Message: "Enter the remarks for the requester"
* Check: Already decided. Message: "Request <no> is already <status>"
* Check: Resubmit by another user. Message: "Only <user> can resubmit this request"
* Check: New user in bulk. Message: "Approve <ref> on its own - the new user's temporary password is shown once"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the approver is not the requester and a returned request, when the approver opens My Approvals and a request, then it shows RETURNED with the remarks and is resubmitted by its requester.
* (AC2) Given the approver is not the requester, when the approver opens My Approvals and a request, then the requester cannot approve their own request.

Taxes (TIN, ATC, VAT) come from the party tax profile.

* Function: BIBS modules ask for payments through the Operations disbursement gateway - remittance batches, cashiering refunds and 2307 releases, commission pass-ons, Payment Requests refunds and cash advances, service-fee payouts. Each request (DSR-yyyy-n) carries the RFP number, payee, disbursement type, amount, currency, attachments, the root invoice and the accounting references to settle.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Types routed straight to the approver - REFUND, REMITTANCE. (Configurable)
* (R2) No-payee behaviour HOLD (default) or RETURN. (Configurable)

* Check: Duplicate request. Message: "Request <ref> was already received"
* Check: Payee not maintained. Message: "Maintain payee <code> before creating the voucher"

column4: Cancel an approved DV and regularise the accounting
column6:
As a Disbursement Approver, I need to cancel "Approved" transaction, so that a cancelled payment leaves the books right.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: DIS 2.20.0 (p.93)
* FRS: FRS BRD-05 Accounting Disbursement ACSL v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-05_Accounting_Disbursement_ACSL_v2.1.docx), section 4.11 Disbursement, FR-DS-044 Cancel an approved DV and regularise the accounting
* Persona: Disbursement Approver
* Function: On request, the Approver cancels an approved DV with a reason. BIBS reverses the DV journal (DV:<no>:CANCEL; posting status REVERSED, or REVERSAL_FAILED with the error), cancels the instrument when it is not final, returns the request to its source and publishes CANCELLED. The source restores its records - Payment Requests reopens the refund; for a remittance DV, Remittance reverses the batch postings with the opposite sign (remittance, incentive, CPC2 and each deduction, which gets its amount back), puts the invoices back in review with the remittance lock, records the cancelled DV and returns the batch to Review in process for its next send cycle (re-approval sends a new request under <batch>/R<n>). When another team has locked one of the invoices since, the batch is left as it is and the remittance processors are notified. Open check-cancellation hand-offs that name the DV are closed.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Cancellation after release (check void versus stale) is open (AQ15). (Fixed)
* Check: Instrument final. Message: "<mode> <instrument> is <status> and cannot be cancelled"
* Check: Cancel without reason. Message: "Select a reason for 'cancel'"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the DV is APPROVED; its instrument is not final (negotiated, credited, debited), when the Approver opens the DV and clicks Cancel approved DV with the reason, then cancelling an approved refund DV posts the reversal and reopens the refund request.
* (AC2) Given the DV is APPROVED; its instrument is not final (negotiated, credited, debited) and a negotiated check's DV, when the Approver opens the DV and clicks Cancel approved DV with the reason, then it cannot be cancelled.

column4: Fund the main BDOIR account with a verifier and two approvers
column6:

*Background*

* Persona: Disbursement Team Leader (maker, verifier); Disbursement Approvers
* Function: A TL creates a funding request (FND-yyyy-n) - source and target BDOIR accounts, amount, purpose - and submits it. Another TL verifies it, and two approvers approve it in turn; either approver can decline it with remarks, and each step can return it to the maker. When the second approval is given, BIBS posts the transfer (DISB_FUND_TRANSFER). The transfer itself is done in BDO Business Online Banking; its reference is recorded on the request. *Business rules*
* (R1) Verifier differs from the maker; each approver differs from the maker, the verifier and the other approver. (Fixed)
* (R2) Accounts, limits and approver order are to be confirmed (AQ10). (Configurable)
* Check: Amount not positive. Message: "The amount must be positive"
* Check: Same account. Message: "The source and target accounts must differ"

* Check: Maker verifies. Message: "The maker cannot verify the funding request"
* Check: Maker or verifier approves. Message: "The maker or verifier cannot approve the funding request"
* Check: Same approver twice. Message: "The second approval must be given by another approver"
* Check: Wrong stage. Message: "Funding request <no> is <stage>"

*Acceptance criteria*

column4: Compute CPC2 incentives per remittance
column6:
As a Disbursement Processor, I need the system to account for the CPC2 incentive separately from the basic commission, so that the CPC2 incentive of each remittance is accounted for apart from commission.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: DIS 3.29.2 (Add.2 p.9-10); Minutes of 4-May-2026 on DIS 3.29.2 (p.1)
* FRS: FRS BRD-05 Accounting Disbursement ACSL v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-05_Accounting_Disbursement_ACSL_v2.1.docx), section 4.11 Disbursement, FR-DS-090 Compute CPC2 incentives per remittance
* Persona: System (remittance extraction and approval)
* Function: CPC2 follows the incentive tag of the booked transaction (minutes of 4 May 2026). At booking, the incentive criteria of code CPC2 maintained by TSU on the products matrix (BRD-3 PMADD07-08) tag the invoice when it qualifies, and the tag is stored on the booked invoice with the criterion code and rate (FR-PM-081). An endorsement that changes the qualification changes the tag of the transaction in New Business and Operations; CPC2 reads only the tag.

*Business rules*
* (R1) CPC2 applies to the lines whose booked transaction carries the CPC2 incentive tag; the rate is the one stored with the tag (minutes p.1; CLR-DS-16). (Configurable)
* (R2) Optional minimum gross premium per criterion. (Configurable)
* (R3) Base (basic premium remitted), VAT treatment and fixed-amount or rule criteria are to be confirmed (AQ24, OQ39, PQ04). (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the booked invoices of the batch carry their incentive tag (FR-PM-081), when the remittance processor extracts the batch, then a packaged Motor line with a basic premium remitted of 100,000.00 and a CPC2 rate of 2% shows CPC2 2,000.00 plus VAT, and the batch payable is reduced by that amount.
* (AC2) Given the booked invoices of the batch carry their incentive tag (FR-PM-081), when the remittance processor extracts the batch, then approving the batch posts OPS_REMIT_CPC2 with the CPC2 income.
* (AC3) Given the booked invoices of the batch carry their incentive tag (FR-PM-081), when the remittance processor extracts the batch, then a line whose booked transaction lost the CPC2 tag through an endorsement gets no CPC2, although the product still matches the CPC2 criteria.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DS-12 - open, for BDOI confirmation: CPC2 incentive (DIS 3.29.2; FR-DS-090). Proposed: CPC2 is computed at the rate of the CPC2 tag of the booked transaction on the basic premium remitted, with output VAT, deducted from the remittance and posted as income (CLR-DS-16). Decision requested: Confirm the base, VAT and criteria (AQ24, OQ39, PQ04).
* CLR-DS-16 - open, for BDOI confirmation: CPC2 follows the incentive tag of the booked transaction (DIS 3.29.2; FR-DS-090, 092). Proposed: A remittance line qualifies for CPC2 only when its booked transaction carries the CPC2 incentive tag set at booking by the CPC2 criteria of Product Maintenance; the CPC2 report lists only those lines. An endorsement that changes the qualification re-tags the transaction in New Business and Operations; Disbursement does not re-evaluate the criteria. Decision requested: Confirm the tag as the basis of CPC2 and of its report; give the CPC2 criteria, base and rate (AQ24); confirm with the New Business and Operations owners that an endorsement re-evaluates the incentive tag.

column4: Issue the service invoice of the early incentive automatically
column6:
As a Disbursement Processor, I need the system to issue the service invoice of each qualified early incentive automatically, with VAT and withholding tax, so that every qualified early incentive is billed to the insurer with its taxes.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: DIS 3.29.1 (Add.2 p.8-9); Minutes of 4-May-2026 on DIS 3.29.2 (p.1)
* FRS: FRS BRD-05 Accounting Disbursement ACSL v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-05_Accounting_Disbursement_ACSL_v2.1.docx), section 4.11 Disbursement, FR-DS-091 Issue the service invoice of the early incentive automatically
* Persona: System (remittance approval, booking)
* Function: When a remittance batch with an early incentive is approved, BIBS issues once per batch a booking service invoice of type EARLY_INCENTIVE to the insurer - incentive, its VAT and withholding tax at EARLY_INCENTIVE_WTAX_RATE (2%) of the incentive, summed per line - and links it on the batch. The incentive OR carries the same withholding per line and names the service invoice. A manual issue of a service invoice type with trigger ON_INCENTIVE is refused.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Withholding tax rate 2%. (Configurable)
* (R2) One early-incentive service invoice per batch, with one line per qualified transaction; a re-sent batch does not issue a second one (minutes p.1; CLR-DS-17). (Fixed)
* (R3) The entry of the insurer's 2% withholding (Dr 1611 / Cr 2211) waits for AQ25; until then the incentive is deducted in full from the remittance. (Fixed)
* Check: Manual issue of an automatic type. Message: "Service invoices of type <type> are issued automatically with the early remittance incentive"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the batch has a qualified early incentive (BRD-2) and an early incentive of 5,000.00, when the remittance approver approves the batch, then it produces one service invoice with 100.00 withholding tax, linked to its batch.
* (AC2) Given the batch has a qualified early incentive (BRD-2), when the remittance approver approves the batch, then issuing an EARLY_INCENTIVE service invoice by hand is refused with SERVICE_INVOICE_AUTOMATIC_ONLY.
* (AC3) Given the batch has a qualified early incentive (BRD-2) and a batch with three qualified transactions, when the remittance approver approves the batch, then it produces one service invoice with three lines, each naming its invoice and incentive, whose amount is the incentive of the batch with its taxes.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DS-13 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Early-incentive service invoice (DIS 3.29.1; FR-DS-091). Proposed: One service invoice per batch with 2% withholding; until AQ25 is answered the incentive is deducted in full from the remittance and the insurer's 2% is not posted. Decision requested: Give the accounting of the 2% withholding (AQ25).
* CLR-DS-17 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Granularity and trigger of the incentive service invoice (DIS 3.29.1; FR-DS-091). Proposed: One EARLY_INCENTIVE service invoice per remittance batch, issued automatically when the batch is approved, with one line per qualified transaction linked to its originating transaction; the amount is the incentive of the batch with VAT and withholding tax. The batch lists its qualified transactions with the service invoice number. Decision requested: Confirm the granularity: one invoice per batch with a line per transaction (proposed), or one invoice per qualified transaction; and the trigger: automatic on approval of the batch (proposed), or generated by a user in one click from the list.

column4: Reconcile the SOA against the booked transactions by invoice number
column6:
As an ACSL Processor, I need the system to perform automatic reconciliation, so that differences with the insurers are found by invoice.

*Background*

* Persona: System; ACSL Processor
* Function: For each SOA line BIBS finds the invoice in the ledger and reports its status - Outstanding, For remittance, Remitted (batch and date), Cancelled (with the cancellation reference), Direct billed (indicator), with the 2307 amount, the SOA balance and the variances of premium and outstanding balance. * (R1) Matching key is the invoice number. (Fixed)
* (R2) Buckets Outstanding, For remittance, Remitted, Cancelled, Direct billed; Not found. (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the upload is loaded and an SOA line whose invoice was remitted in batch RB-2026-12, when BIBS reconciles the lines, then it shows Remitted with that batch and date.
* (AC2) Given the upload is loaded and an SOA line with an unknown invoice, when BIBS reconciles the lines, then it is Not found.

column4: Reconcile GL and SL balances by GL code

* Persona: System (job ACSL_GL_SL_RECON); ACSL users
* Function: For each control account set up, BIBS compares the GL balance with its sub-ledger - the party ledger of the Operations components, or the open items of given document types - and shows the difference. *Business rules*
* (R1) Submission needs the insurer's confirmation reference and date. (Fixed)
* (R2) The confirmer is not the preparer. (Fixed)

* Check: Changed after submission. Message: "Deduction <no> can only change as a draft"

* Persona: System (job RNW_EXTRACTION)
* Function: Every day BIBS extracts as renewal candidates the booked root invoices (policy years) whose policy expiry date equals the business date plus the lead days (default 140 days; a value per segment may override it). Extraction is expiry-based, not maturity-based (BRRN.030 AC1).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Lead days 140 (default); per-segment values override it. (Configurable)
* (R2) One open candidate per expiring invoice (unique company + expiring invoice no.). (Fixed)
* (R3) Employee Benefits lines (HMO, GLI, GPA) are excluded (decision D3). (Configurable)
* (R4) Extraction never starts the renewal and never guarantees renewability (BRRN.021, BRRN.030 AC3). (Fixed)
* (R5) Job time 01:00 PHT. (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the job is active, when the job runs at 01:00 PHT, then a policy expiring 140 days after the business date becomes a candidate that day, with a renewal reference, and does not appear twice after a second run.
* (AC2) Given the job is active, when the job runs at 01:00 PHT, then a change of the lead days to 150 takes effect at the next run without a release.
* (AC3) Given the job is active and an HMO policy, when the job runs at 01:00 PHT, then it is not extracted.
* (AC4) Given the job is active, when the job runs at 01:00 PHT, then the extraction run records its date, time and trigger, and a policy is never extracted twice in the same cycle (BRRN.030, Walkthrough addendum p.8).

column4: Take over the expiries of the go-live window

* Persona: Processing TL (runs the go-live extraction from the cut-over runbook); Renewal processing team
* Function: At go-live BIBS takes over every renewal that expires from go-live to 31 May 2028. BDOI decided on 26-Sep-2026 that these renewals are processed in BIBS after go-live and that no renewal in progress is carried from the legacy systems (BRD-13 question DMQ37).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Window from the go-live date to 31 May 2028; urgent up to 31 January 2028. (Configurable)
* (R2) One candidate per legacy policy reference; the daily extraction skips policies already taken over. (Fixed)
* (R3) An RA recorded from the tracker is never generated or sent again for the same candidate. (Fixed)
* (R4) Rejected tracker rows are applied only after a second member of the Renewal processing team approves the correction (maker-checker). (Fixed)
* (R5) The job runs once; a second run creates nothing new and is recorded with zero new candidates. (Fixed)
* Check: Tracker row whose legacy policy reference has no candidate. Message: "Row <n>: no renewal candidate for legacy policy <reference>"
* Check: Second tracker row for the same policy. Message: "Row <n>: the Renewal Advice of legacy policy <reference> is already recorded"

column4: Run the sanitation, matching and eligibility checks
column6:
As a renewal processor, I want data sanitation to occur within the system after extraction or upload, so that renewal eligibility is determined consistently and does not depend on manual pre-cleaning.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.020 (p.30; p.5, 20-21); BRRN.022 (p.30)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.3 Sanitation, buckets and rules, FR-RN-020 Run the sanitation, matching and eligibility checks
* Persona: System (check engine); Renewal processor (view)
* Function: After extraction, after every upload and on every relevant event, BIBS runs the checks of section 5.3 on the candidate - reference match, PN present, risk code renewable, risk code defined, insurer renewable list, TSI threshold, LAMD status, claims, pending endorsement, outstanding premium, financial impact, insurer response match, mandatory fields, product renewable, insurer usable, duplicate candidate and KYC due. Eligibility no longer depends on manual pre-cleaning of the list.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Checks and their default severities are those of section 5.3, set from the sanitation criteria of the Walkthrough addendum (RQ01 answered in part). (Configurable)
* (R4) TSI threshold PHP 250,000,000.00; above it the candidate is Review and the matrix proposes For Proposal to TSU (SC-12, SC-13, R23-02, R24-02). (Configurable)
* (R5) A change of the check settings applies to the candidates not yet initiated; candidates in progress keep their results until their next event. (Fixed)
* (R2) Re-evaluation when an invoice is booked or moves, when the account status changes, after every upload and nightly (job RNW_REEVALUATE). (Fixed)
* (R3) KYC due is information only and never blocks (BRRN.028). (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*

column4: Classify candidates into Clean, Review and Exception buckets
column6:
As a Renewal user, I want the system to classify renewal records automatically into rule-based buckets (Clean, Review, Exception), so that renewal work is prioritised, straight-through cases are processed efficiently, and exceptions are controlled and isolated.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.023 (p.30-32; p.5-6, 21); BRRN.029 (p.34; p.7-8, 23; rule R29-05, exception ageing)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.3 Sanitation, buckets and rules, FR-RN-022 Classify candidates into Clean, Review and Exception buckets
* Persona: System; authorised user (override)
* Function: After each check run BIBS computes the bucket from the active bucket rule set. By default any check that fails with severity FAIL_EXCEPTION gives Exception; any FAIL_REVIEW or WARN gives Review; otherwise Clean. Records move between buckets when conditions change.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Default rule set: FAIL_EXCEPTION gives EXCEPTION; FAIL_REVIEW or WARN gives REVIEW; otherwise CLEAN. (Configurable)
* (R2) A failed check never gives CLEAN, by rule or by override. (Fixed)
* (R3) Every bucket change is logged with the rule-set version, rule, check run, cause and user. (Fixed)
* (R4) Exception ageing: 5 working days by default (R29-05; days and recipients to confirm, CLR-RN-27). (Configurable)
* Check: Override to Clean with a failed check. Message: "Renewal <ref> has failed checks and cannot be Clean"
* Check: Override without remarks. Message: "Enter the remarks of the override"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a check run exists and a candidate with an open claim, when BIBS evaluates the bucket rules on the latest results and stores the bucket with the rule-set version, then it is Review, never Clean.
* (AC2) Given a check run exists, when the claim closes, then the candidate becomes Clean at the next re-evaluation and the bucket history shows both entries.
* (AC3) Given a check run exists and an override to Clean on a record with a failed check, when BIBS evaluates the bucket rules on the latest results and stores the bucket with the rule-set version, then it is refused.
* (AC4) Given a check run exists, when BIBS evaluates the bucket rules on the latest results and stores the bucket with the rule-set version, then the Checks & Bucket tab shows, for each bucket change, the rule-set version and the rule that set it.

column4: Apply the decision matrix and rule-based disposition
column6:

* Persona: System; Business Administrator (matrix); authorised user (override)
* Function: After initiation BIBS evaluates the active decision matrix on Clean and Review candidates. The first rule by priority gives a proposed disposition and an automation flag. * (R2) Only one ACTIVE matrix version at a time; activation by a checker who is not the maker. (Fixed)
* (R3) Matrix content is supplied by BDOI (RQ24); none ships with production. (Configurable)
* (R4) The condition TOTAL_LOSS is inactive until Claims defines a total-loss indicator (CLQ28). (Fixed)

* Check: Rule without outcome. Message: "Select the disposition of the rule"

column4: Tag non-renewable risk codes and send the NFR
column6:
As a Business Administrator, I need non-renewable risk codes tagged, excluded and maintained with the Not for Renewal Letter sent, so that such accounts are closed without manual work.

column4: Flag accounts due for KYC review

*Background*

* Persona: System; any list user
* Function: BIBS flags candidates whose client is due or upcoming for KYC review, using the client's KYC review date and the KYC due window. The flag shows as a chip in the lists and a column in the reports, with the date it was first identified. It is for visibility and reporting only and never blocks, stops or reroutes the renewal.

* (R1) Severity INFO only; the flag is never an input of the bucket rules. (Fixed)

* (R3) Due window from the client master. (Configurable)

* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS and a candidate whose client KYC review is due in 20 days, when the check KYC_DUE runs with the other checks, then it shows the KYC due chip, and its bucket is unchanged.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the check KYC_DUE runs with the other checks, then the renewal status report shows the flag and the date it was identified.

* CLR-RN-30 - open, for BDOI confirmation: KYC at renewal (BRRN.028 and its annex; FR-RN-026). Proposed: KYC stays for visibility only and never blocks the renewal (BRRN.028, scope of the Walkthrough addendum). column4: Resolve the package of a migrated policy at sanitation
column6:
As a renewal processor, I want data sanitation to occur within the system after extraction or upload, so that renewal eligibility is determined consistently and does not depend on manual pre-cleaning.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.020 (p.30; p.5, 20-21)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.3 Sanitation, buckets and rules, FR-RN-028 Resolve the package of a migrated policy at sanitation
* Persona: System (check PACKAGE_REMAP); Renewal processing team (Processing TL, Processing Officer)
* Function: A migrated policy carries its legacy package code. BDOI decided on 26-Sep-2026 that legacy packages are remapped to the BIBS packages at sanitation, not at the data migration (BRD-13 question DMQ36). The migration only loads the legacy package code and the package code map.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only active package versions sellable for renewal can be chosen (PRODUCT_RENEWABLE still applies). (Fixed)
* (R2) Maker and checker are different users. (Fixed)
* (R3) A failed PACKAGE_REMAP puts the candidate in the Exception bucket. (Configurable)
* Check: No package version chosen, or no reason. Message: "Choose the package version and give the reason"
* Check: Checker is the maker. Message: "The package choice must be approved by another user"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the candidate has source Legacy; the user has RNW_PACKAGE_REMAP, when the check runs after the go-live extraction and at every re-evaluation, then a migrated policy whose legacy package maps to one BIBS version passes the check and shows that version.
* (AC2) Given the candidate has source Legacy; the user has RNW_PACKAGE_REMAP and a migrated policy with an unmapped package, when the check runs after the go-live extraction and at every re-evaluation, then it is in the Exception bucket until a processor's choice is approved by a second processor.
* (AC3) Given the candidate has source Legacy; the user has RNW_PACKAGE_REMAP, when the check runs after the go-live extraction and at every re-evaluation, then the same user cannot choose and approve the package.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-RN-07 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Package of a migrated policy (FR-RN-028). Proposed: The legacy package is remapped at sanitation from the package code map; when the map gives no single active version, a Processing member chooses the version and another member approves it. Decision requested: Confirm the maker-checker choice of the package.

column4: Generate and send the closing letters (NAL and NRL)
column6:
As a Processing Officer or Marketing AO, I need to generate and send the No Advice Letter, the Non-Renewal Letter and the Renewal Advice to the accounts that meet their criteria, so that every client receives the right letter and the account status follows.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.001 (p.48; updated p.15-16); BRRN.037 (p.39; p.12, 24-26; rules R37-HC-07 to 12)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.9 Letters, acceptance and follow-up, FR-RN-082 Generate and send the closing letters (NAL and NRL)
* Persona: Operations / Processing user (NAL); Marketing AO (NRL / NFR); System (eligibility)
* Function: The Letters screen lists the accounts eligible for each letter on its criteria - Renewal Advice (FR-RN-080), No Advice Letter (NAL) and Non-Renewal Letter (NRL, the Not for Renewal Letter of FR-RN-024) - with the filters period, market segment and unit head (updated BRRN.001). The user selects one or several accounts and generates and sends the letters from the approved templates; BIBS stores them, updates the account status (NAL Sent or NRL Sent), confirms the result and notifies the user of letters that could not be produced or sent.

*Business rules*
* (R1) NAL when the account is unrenewed at its effective expiry date and an RA was sent; NRL when no RA exists (R37-HC-07, 08); eligibility to confirm (RQ17, CLR-RN-32). (Configurable)
* (R2) NAL and NRL are mutually exclusive for an account (R37-HC-09, 10). (Fixed)
* (R3) No closing letter before the effective expiry date (R37-HC-05). (Fixed)
* Check: Ineligible account selected. Message: "Renewal <ref> already has a <letter> and cannot receive a NAL"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the accounts are eligible for the letter; the user holds the letter permission of his unit and a NAL, when the user opens the Letters tab of the letter, which lists the eligible accounts, and filters them, then it is sent to an eligible account and the account shows NAL Sent.
* (AC2) Given the accounts are eligible for the letter; the user holds the letter permission of his unit and an account with a NAL, when the user opens the Letters tab of the letter, which lists the eligible accounts, and filters them, then it cannot receive an NRL, and an account with an NRL cannot receive a NAL.
* (AC3) Given the accounts are eligible for the letter; the user holds the letter permission of his unit and an unrenewed account without RA at its effective expiry date, when the user opens the Letters tab of the letter, which lists the eligible accounts, and filters them, then it is listed for its Marketing AO for the NRL; one with an RA sent is listed for Operations for the NAL.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-RN-13 - open, for BDOI confirmation: No Advice Letter (FR-RN-082). Proposed: Eligibility comes from the NAL-eligible attribute of the non-renewal reason and from the routing at the effective expiry date (CLR-RN-32). Decision requested: Confirm the NAL-eligible reasons (RQ17).

Proposed: The screens write the letters in full: Renewal Advice, No Advice Letter, Not for Renewal Letter; the tab of the closing letters is "NAL / NFR". Decision requested: Confirm the letter names and the tab label (see CLR-RN-32).
* CLR-RN-22 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Side stages on the step bar (FR-RN-031, 048, 082). Proposed: Transfer Pending, the New Business path and Letter Pending show apart from the main stages of the step bar, after the stage they come from. Decision requested: Confirm the step bar.
* CLR-RN-32 - open, for BDOI confirmation: NAL and NRL (updated BRRN.001, R37-HC-07 to 10; FR-RN-024, 082). Proposed: At the effective expiry date an unrenewed account with an RA sent goes to Operations for the NAL; one without RA goes to its Marketing AO for the NRL, which is the Not for Renewal Letter; the two letters exclude each other. Decision requested: Confirm the NAL definition and that the NRL is the Not for Renewal Letter (RQ07, RQ17).
