column4: NRNS reminders and non-acceptance letters
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need NRNS reminders and non-acceptance letters sent at the checkpoints, so that lapses are prevented and recorded.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.025 (p.32); BRRN.037 (p.39; p.12, 24-26)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.9 Letters, acceptance and follow-up, FR-RN-083 NRNS reminders and non-acceptance letters
* Persona: System (job RNW_NRNS_LETTERS, RNW_EXPIRY_SWEEP)
* Function: BIBS classifies as NRNS (No Renew / No Submit) the accounts that are not yet submitted at the checkpoint (no disposition, or For Renewal without RA acceptance). At the checkpoint (90 days before expiry by default) the daily job generates a reminder letter; policies already submitted or in progress are excluded.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Reminder checkpoint 90 days before expiry (the BRD also writes '+90 days'; RQ18). (Configurable)
* (R2) Non-acceptance at expiry (0 days) by default. (Configurable)
* (R3) One reminder per candidate and checkpoint. (Fixed)
* (R4) Waiting period after the effective expiry date before the NRNS tag: 0 days by default, per segment (CBG, non-CBG; CLR-RN-33). (Configurable)
* (R5) Effective expiry date = end of the confirmed hold cover, otherwise the policy expiry date. (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT and sets the NRNS flag, then a candidate without disposition 90 days before expiry gets one reminder letter and the NRNS chip.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS and a candidate already disposed For Renewal and accepted, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT and sets the NRNS flag, then it gets no reminder.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT and sets the NRNS flag, then at expiry without acceptance the candidate closes EXPIRED_UNRENEWED with a non-acceptance letter.
* (AC4) Given the step is due in BIBS and a candidate with a confirmed 30-day hold cover, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT and sets the NRNS flag, then it is not tagged NRNS and gets no closing letter until the hold cover ends.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-RN-14 - open, for BDOI confirmation: NRNS and non-acceptance (FR-RN-083). Proposed: Accounts not yet submitted at the checkpoint (90 days before expiry by default) are NRNS; reminders and non-acceptance letters follow the default days. Decision requested: Confirm the definition and the timing (RQ18).
* CLR-RN-33 - open, for BDOI confirmation: NRNS waiting period (Annex BRRN.037; FR-RN-083). Proposed: NRNS is tagged at the effective expiry date with no waiting period by default; the waiting days are a parameter per segment (CBG, non-CBG). Decision requested: Give the waiting days per segment (RQ18).

column4: Record client acceptance and proceed to placement and booking
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I need the accepted renewal to move to placement and booking without re-keying, so that the renewal completes quickly and books as a renewal.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.040 (p.40-41); BRRN.038 AC3 (p.40); BRRN.035 (p.37-38; p.9-11, 23-24; client confirmation, manual placement and booking)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.9 Letters, acceptance and follow-up, FR-RN-084 Record client acceptance and proceed to placement and booking
* Persona: Marketing AO (confirmation, RNW_ACCEPT); Processing (placement); booking user (BRD-1); System
* Function: The user records the client's acceptance of the RA with its method - e-mail (attachment RA_ACCEPTANCE), signed RA (attachment SIGNED_RA) or payment (the payment gate's evidence) - and the evidence. BIBS marks the renewal Accepted.

*Business rules*
* (R1) No duplicate proposal, resubmission or new initiation: the renewal account is the one created at processing. (Fixed)
* (R2) Automatic placement off by default for renewals: placement and booking are user actions (Walkthrough addendum p.4). (Configurable)
* (R3) Evidence is mandatory when FINANCIAL_IMPACT failed (BRRN.038). (Fixed)
* (R4) Payment rules are the BRD-1 payment gate (RQ19). (Fixed)
* Check: Method not selected. Message: "Select the acceptance method"
* Check: Evidence missing. Message: "Attach the acceptance evidence"
* Check: Blocking check open. Message: "Renewal <ref> cannot be accepted: <check> failed"
* Check: Renewal account incomplete. Message: "Complete the mandatory fields of <product>: <fields>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the candidate is RA_SENT; the user has RNW_ACCEPT, when the user clicks Record Acceptance, chooses the method and attaches the evidence, then after the AO records the acceptance and the payment gate passes, the Processing user places and the booking user books the renewal account without re-keying; nothing is placed without a user action.
* (AC2) Given the candidate is RA_SENT; the user has RNW_ACCEPT, when the user clicks Record Acceptance, chooses the method and attaches the evidence, then the booked invoice shows business type RENEWAL and the candidate is RENEWED.
* (AC3) Given the candidate is RA_SENT; the user has RNW_ACCEPT, when the user clicks Record Acceptance, chooses the method and attaches the evidence, then Acceptance of a renewal with a failed financial-impact check needs evidence.

Proposed: The AO records the client's confirmation; placement and booking are user actions (automatic placement off for renewals); the account moves on without re-keying. Decision requested: Confirm that automatic placement of BRRN.040 is superseded (RQ19).

column4: Request and confirm a hold cover from the renewal
column6:
As a Marketing AO, I want to send a hold cover request to the insurer and record the hold cover confirmation it returns, so that the cover continues while the renewal completes.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRRN.042 (p.14-15); BRRN.037 (p.39; p.12, 24-26; rules R37-HC-01 to 04)
* FRS: FRS BRD-06 Renewal v2.0 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-06_Renewal_v2.0.docx), section 4.9 Letters, acceptance and follow-up, FR-RN-086 Request and confirm a hold cover from the renewal
* Persona: Marketing AO (request, tag); Processing (insurer confirmation); System
* Function: When a renewal will not complete before the policy expires, the user sends a hold cover request to the insurer from the renewal, with the insurer, the coverage start date (the policy expiry date by default), the duration (30 or 60 days), the expiring policy number and remarks. BIBS records the request date, the requester and, when known, the insurer reference, and e-mails the request from the hold cover template (the request of FR-NB-082, opened from the renewal account).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Durations 30 or 60 days; default 30. (Configurable)
* (R2) One open hold cover per renewal; a new request needs the previous one expired or cancelled. (Fixed)
* (R3) The effective expiry date is the end of the confirmed hold cover, otherwise the policy expiry date. (Fixed)
* Check: Hold cover already open. Message: "Account <arn> already has a hold cover requested or confirmed"
* Check: Duration not chosen. Message: "Select the duration of the hold cover"

column4: Evaluate the incentive eligibility of a renewal after booking and full payment
column6:

* Persona: System (incentive evaluation); report and invoice users (view)
* Function: A renewal is evaluated for incentive eligibility only when all of these hold - the renewal account is placed and booked, the client's acceptance is confirmed through Marketing (FR-RN-084), the payment status is Fully Paid and no payment rule is unmet. No evaluation is made at the insurer response, processing or pre-booking stages.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Evaluation only after booking, confirmed acceptance and full payment, with no unmet payment rule. (Fixed)
* (R2) The indicator cannot be set or changed by hand. (Fixed)
* (R3) Criteria content from the incentive criteria of Product Maintenance (Q33). (Configurable)

* (AC1) Given Active incentive criteria exist and a booked renewal not yet fully paid, when the renewal account is booked; the acceptance is confirmed; the payment becomes Fully Paid, then it has no incentive indicator; when it becomes Fully Paid and the acceptance is confirmed, the indicator is set from the matching criteria.
* (AC2) Given Active incentive criteria exist, when the renewal account is booked; the acceptance is confirmed; the payment becomes Fully Paid, then a renewal cancelled after booking shows the indicator invalidated, with the reason in the history.

* Persona: Contact Center Agent (CSF_CONTACT_UPDATE)
* Function: Before an update the agent verifies the caller's identity with a checklist - address, contact number, e-mail, insured property details - recording for each check whether it matched, and the channel (hotline, e-mail, website). column4: Queue contact changes for QPS and EBIX while they coexist
column6:
As a BDO Insure Contact Center Agent, I need to access client and account information from the source systems, so that I can view and update customer details.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCSF-002 (p.24); Executive summary and envisioned process (p.20, p.22)
* FRS: FRS BRD-09 Customer Servicing Facility v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-09_Customer_Servicing_Facility_v1.1.docx), section 4.3 Contact details, FR-CSF-022 Queue contact changes for QPS and EBIX while they coexist
* Persona: System
* Function: The BRD asks that contact updates be sent back to the data sources (QPS and EBIX, p.20). In BIBS the client master is updated at once; the write-back to QPS and EBIX, which matters only while they coexist, goes through an outbox. Until BDOI specifies the interface, each change is stored with the status "not configured" and nothing is sent. When the interface exists, a job sends queued changes every 15 minutes, retries failures and raises an alert.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Sync off until the interface is specified (CSQ01). (Configurable)
* (R2) Every change keeps its content, so it can be sent again. (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a contact change was applied and sync disabled, when BIBS writes the outbox rows for QPS and EBIX, then a contact change shows the sync status "Not configured".
* (AC2) Given a contact change was applied, when BIBS writes the outbox rows for QPS and EBIX, then the CSF Contact Changes report lists the sync status of each change.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-CSF-01 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Data source and write-back (BRCSF-002, p.20, p.22; FR-CSF-022). Proposed: BIBS is the source of the client and account data. A contact change updates the BIBS client master at once and is kept for QPS and EBIX with the status "not configured"; it is sent when BDOI specifies the interface. Decision requested: Say until when QPS and EBIX stay systems of record and whether a write-back is needed (CSQ01).

* (R3) A potential match at or above the case threshold opens or joins a case (FR-SS-034); below it, it waits on the Matches screen. (Configurable)
* (R4) Names are normalised before scoring (case, accents, punctuation, honorifics, word order). (Fixed)
* (R5) A hit on an alias counts as a hit on the entry (to confirm, SQ02). (Configurable)

* Persona: Compliance Officer (maker); Compliance Checker
* Function: The approval matrix decides where a submitted case goes. A route has a from-stage, conditions (case type, risk category, marketing unit, disposition), a to-stage and the approver - the Unit Head of the client's marketing unit, a role or a named user - with an order.

*Business rules*
* (R1) An entry is identified by source and external reference; a record already loaded is updated, not duplicated. (Fixed)
* (R2) An entry missing from a full-file source is delisted (status INACTIVE, delisting date set), never deleted. (Fixed)
* (R3) Schedules run outside 08:00-17:00 by default (peak hours, p.24). (Configurable)
* (R4) List sources, formats, frequency and transport are confirmed by BDOI (SQ01). (Configurable)

* Function: Matching starts without user action. When a client is created, BIBS screens the new client only, with the active matching criteria and the active list. * (AC2) Given an ACTIVE matching-criteria version exists, when a trigger fires (client created, identity changed, account submitted, list change or batch window), then the batch run processes all prospects and confirmed clients and no inactive client.

column6:

* Persona: System
* Function: Every system and user action writes an audit entry that no user can alter or delete. No entry of the platform audit log can be changed. * FRS: FRS BRD-12 Submitted Policies v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-12_Submitted_Policies_v1.1.docx), section 4.3 Rules and processing, FR-SP-021 Run processing automatically after intake
* Persona: System (job SBM_PROCESSING); Sanitation Handler (SBM_PROCESS)
* Function: When documents or files are uploaded and confirmed, BIBS runs the processing steps in order - sanitation, matching against the loan files (FR-SP-035), classification, disposition and limits - and triggers the workflow of each record by its result (renewal hand-off, manual disposition queue, non-renewal, policy review, TOR). *Business rules*
* (R1) Step order - SANITATION, MATCHING, CLASSIFICATION, DISPOSITION, LIMITS. (Fixed)

* (R3) Matching checks PN and loan application number against the loan files (LAMD, LMS, LAD) and PN against serial / motor number and assured name / address / contacts (RL p.24). (Configurable)
* (R4) Job time 21:30 PHT. (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given Active rule sets exist for the steps, when an intake commit, the job or a user starts the run for a scope, then uploading an LFS file starts a run; each new record ends with a classification and a bucket or fallout.
* (AC2) Given Active rule sets exist for the steps and a record matched to an active loan of the loan files, when an intake commit, the job or a user starts the run for a scope, then it is moved to the right bucket and the handlers are notified.

* Persona: System; Sanitation Handler

*Business rules*
* (R1) Every fallout row has a reason code (LOV SBM_REASON). (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a run or intake has ended and a run with five records without PN, when the run ends; BIBS writes the fallout rows and raises SBM_FALLOUT when the count is above zero, then it produces a fallout report listing the five with their reason code.
* (AC2) Given a run or intake has ended and a corrected record, when the run ends; BIBS writes the fallout rows and raises SBM_FALLOUT when the count is above zero, then it leaves the fallout after the next run.

column4: Record policy reviews and generate one IAAF per policy
column6:

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRIDSP-07 (p.9); BRIDSP-08 (p.9)
* FRS: FRS BRD-12 Submitted Policies v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-12_Submitted_Policies_v1.1.docx), section 4.5 Policy review and IAAF, FR-SP-040 Record policy reviews and generate one IAAF per policy
* Persona: Marketing user (Policy Reviewer, Submitted Handler; IAAF_PREPARE)
* Function: Non-CBG Corporate and Branch records and CBG Fire records with documents enter the review queue. The reviewer records each review - review number, date, adequacy (Adequate or With findings), findings and remarks. With findings, the reviewer e-mails the bank counterpart from the record and a new review follows. The IAAF shows the review history and the review count.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One IAAF per policy; the BRD's current-process note that one IAAF may cover several policies is handled with links (SP SQ07). (Fixed)
* (R2) Template SBM_IAAF; draft until BDOI provides the layout. (Configurable)
* (R3) IAAF reference Region Code-Year-Counter; region code from the referring branch (SP SQ30). (Configurable)
* Check: Second IAAF for the policy. Message: "Policy <SBM no.> already has IAAF <no.>"
* Check: Adequacy not selected. Message: "Select the adequacy"
* Check: IAAF with findings open. Message: "The last review has findings; record an adequate review first"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the record is IN_REVIEW; the user has IAAF_PREPARE and a policy reviewed twice, when the reviewer opens the record from the review queue and records the review, then it shows two reviews and a review count of 2 on its IAAF.
* (AC2) Given the record is IN_REVIEW; the user has IAAF_PREPARE and a second IAAF for the same policy, when the reviewer opens the record from the review queue and records the review, then it is refused.
* (AC3) Given the record is IN_REVIEW; the user has IAAF_PREPARE and an IAAF linked to the previous term's record, when the reviewer opens the record from the review queue and records the review, then it shows the link.
* (AC4) Given the record is IN_REVIEW; the user has IAAF_PREPARE, when the reviewer opens the record from the review queue and records the review, then the IAAF of a record referred by a branch of region NCR is numbered NCR-<year>-<counter>.

column4: Route the IAAF for approval and signature
column6:

* Persona: System; approvers (IAAF_APPROVE)
* Function: The IAAF Approval Matrix gives, for the document IAAF, the segment and the sum-insured band, the approval levels and the permission or named signatory of each level. When the IAAF is submitted, BIBS routes it to the first level; each approval moves it to the next level until the last one.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Levels, criteria and signatories of the matrix are to be supplied by BDOI (SP SQ07). (Configurable)
* (R2) The preparer never approves a level. (Fixed)
* (R3) The signature is a stamped signature until a qualified e-signature is connected. (Fixed)
* Check: Approver is the preparer. Message: "An IAAF is approved by someone other than its preparer"
* Check: Return without reason. Message: "Select a reason for 'Return'"

* (AC2) Given the IAAF is FOR_APPROVAL; the user holds the permission of the current level and did not prepare the IAAF, when the approver opens the IAAF from My Approvals and reviews it, then the preparer cannot approve it.
* (AC3) Given the IAAF is FOR_APPROVAL; the user holds the permission of the current level and did not prepare the IAAF, when the approver opens the IAAF from My Approvals and reviews it, then the issued IAAF PDF shows the stamped name, position and time of every approver.

* Persona: System (job SBM_EXPIRY_SCAN); Marketing AO (Renew with BDOI)
* Function: Every day the expiry scan selects For Renewal records whose expiry falls within the lead days of their segment (for example CBG Fire 150 days, CBG Motor 120 days), assigns the insurer with the insurer rules (by vehicle type for CBG Motor; different from the expiring insurer for CBG Fire), and hands each record to the Renewal module with the policy and risk data, the RA template and the assigned insurer. The record moves to RENEWAL_IN_PROGRESS.

*Business rules*

* (R2) Insurer rules by segment, vehicle type or occupancy; exclude the expiring insurer where set. A preferred insurer assigned to a released proposal (FR-SP-067) replaces the rule result. (Configurable)
* (R3) One hand-off per record and term; a repeat for the same SBM number creates nothing new. (Fixed)
* Check: Renew with BDOI on a record not For Renewal. Message: "Policy <SBM no.> is not For Renewal"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the record is FOR_RENEWAL, when the job runs at 22:00 PHT and selects the records, then a For Renewal CBG Fire record 150 days before expiry is handed over with an insurer different from the expiring one.
* (AC2) Given the record is FOR_RENEWAL and a second scan, when the job runs at 22:00 PHT and selects the records, then it does not hand the same record over again.
* (AC3) Given the record is FOR_RENEWAL, when the job runs at 22:00 PHT and selects the records, then while Renewal is not in use, the hand-off shows as pending and no letter is sent.

Decision requested: Confirm decision D2.

* CLR-SP-06 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Hand-off lead days (FR-SP-060). Proposed: Records are handed over 150 days before expiry for CBG Fire and 120 days for CBG Motor (defaults). Decision requested: Confirm the lead days.

column4: Send notifications and alerts for key events
column6:
As a Team Lead, I need BIBS to generate and send notifications for the key policy events and exceptions to recipients I can define, so that they are informed and act on time without manual follow-up.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRIDSP-28 (p.11)
* FRS: FRS BRD-12 Submitted Policies v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-12_Submitted_Policies_v1.1.docx), section 4.10 Monitoring, reports and notifications, FR-SP-082 Send notifications and alerts for key events
* Persona: System; rule administrator (recipient set-up)
* Function: BIBS evaluates the notification rules and thresholds on each lifecycle event and notifies the intended or assigned recipients in the app and, per their preferences, by e-mail. The recipients of each event type are defined on Notification Recipients - roles, named users, the assigned handler or AO of the record, and outside e-mail addresses for the bank counterpart - with the segment they apply to. The events are those of BRIDSP-28 (section 5.6) - new submission or manual validation, pending IAAF or TOR, bucket moves, exceptions and fallout, nearing expiry and renewal start, TOR hand-over, placement file ready or sent, and the alert for hold covers of unbooked accounts.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Hold cover of an unbooked account is alerted 5 days (default) before the hold cover ends. (Configurable)
* (R2) Users choose in-app and e-mail per event type. (Configurable)
* (R3) Recipients per event type - roles, named users, assigned handler or AO, outside addresses - and segment; each event type can be switched off. (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS, when an event occurs, then the approvers of level 1 are notified when an IAAF is submitted.
* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS, when an event occurs, then a confirmed hold cover whose account is not booked 5 days before it ends raises SBM_HOLD_COVER_UNBOOKED.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS, when an event occurs, then a named user added as recipient of SBM_TOR_RELEASED for CBG Fire receives the next TOR hand-over notice of a CBG Fire record.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-SP-18 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Notification recipients (BRIDSP-28; FR-SP-082). Proposed: The recipients of each event type are defined on a set-up screen (roles, named users, assigned handler or AO, outside addresses, per segment). column4: Report the expiring accounts of a month and the active loans without an active policy
column6:
As a Sanitation Handler, I need a report of all accounts with policies expiring in a given month and a list of active loan accounts without an active policy, so that expiring and uninsured loans are followed up.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRIDSP-03 (p.9)
* FRS: FRS BRD-12 Submitted Policies v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-12_Submitted_Policies_v1.1.docx), section 4.10 Monitoring, reports and notifications, FR-SP-083 Report the expiring accounts of a month and the active loans without an active policy
* Persona: Marketing user (SBM_REPORT_VIEW)
* Function: For the reporting month the user chooses, the report SBM-EXPIRING-UNINSURED gives two parts. Part 1 lists every masterlist account whose policy expires in that month, with its segment, classification, bucket, renewal tag, insurer, policy, expiry date, handler and renewal status. Part 2 lists every active loan account of the latest loan files (FR-SP-035) that has no active insurance policy - no masterlist record and no BIBS policy in force on the last day of the month, or only expired ones - with the loan report, PN number, loan application number, borrower, branch, segment, loan status and the expiry date of the last policy known.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Active loan = loan status Active in the latest loan file of each loan report on or before the month end (SP SQ28). (Configurable)
* (R2) Active policy = a masterlist record or BIBS policy whose period covers the last day of the month. (Fixed)
* Check: Reporting month blank. Message: "Select the reporting month"
* Check: No loan file for the month. Message: "No loan file is loaded for <month>. Part 2 uses the file of <date>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has SBM_REPORT_VIEW; loan files are loaded for the month, when the user opens SBM-EXPIRING-UNINSURED and selects the reporting month and the segments, then the report for March lists every account in scope whose policy expires in March.
* (AC2) Given the user has SBM_REPORT_VIEW; loan files are loaded for the month and an active LMS loan without any policy in force at the end of March, when the user opens SBM-EXPIRING-UNINSURED and selects the reporting month and the segments, then it appears in Part 2 with its PN number and loan application number.
* (AC3) Given the user has SBM_REPORT_VIEW; loan files are loaded for the month and a loan whose policy runs beyond March, when the user opens SBM-EXPIRING-UNINSURED and selects the reporting month and the segments, then it does not appear in Part 2.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-SP-13 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Monthly expiring and uninsured-loan report (BRIDSP-03; FR-SP-083; SP SQ28). Proposed: Part 1 lists the accounts whose policy expires in the month; part 2 lists the loans that are Active in the latest loan file of the month and have no policy covering the last day of the month. Decision requested: Confirm the source, the rule and the columns.
